jobs.title: Director of Financial Systems
jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

  • Job Description Summary

    This role owns the financial systems landscape the accounting organization runs on, and leads the design, implementation and continuous improvement of those systems. The Director, Financial Systems is accountable for NetSuite, Concur, Celigo, Solution 7 and the financial components of Workday, for the integrity of financial data moving between those platforms and the general ledger, and for the control environment over financial systems. The role serves as project manager for all system-related initiatives across Accounting, is the accounting owner of the AS400 conversion, and leads the company's outside implementation and support consultants. Reporting to the Vice President, Accounting, the Director partners across Accounting, Information Technology, FP&A and the business to deliver systems, automation and process improvement that reduce manual effort, cycle time and risk across the accounting organization. The Director also owns the accounts payable process the role designed and automated, and leads the accounts payable team.

  • Job Description

    Duties and Responsibilities

    • Own the financial systems landscape for Accounting, including NetSuite, Concur, Celigo, Solution 7 and the financial components of Workday, together with the integrations connecting them to operational platforms and the general ledger.

    • Serve as project manager for all system-related initiatives across Accounting, covering intake and prioritization, scoping, business case, resourcing, schedule, budget, status reporting, risk and issue management, and post-implementation review.

    • Serve as the accounting owner of the AS400 conversion, including requirements definition, data mapping and validation, cutover planning, parallel testing, validation of converted balances and post-conversion stabilization.

    • Direct the company's offshore financial systems support capacity, currently CW Global Partners on an hourly as-needed basis and Vincent Cloud under an annual support agreement, covering scope and statements of work, service levels, budget, deliverable quality and escalation.

    • Lead financial system implementations, upgrades and integrations end to end: requirements, configuration, user acceptance testing, training, cutover and hypercare.

    • Design and build automation that reduces manual effort and cycle time in the close, including automated reconciliations, allocations, recurring entries and management reporting.

    • Own the accounts payable process end to end, including the automated workflow the role designed and implemented, exception handling, vendor master governance, and continuous improvement of throughput and accuracy.

    • Lead the accounts payable team, including performance management, development, workload prioritization and coverage planning.

    • Maintain segregation of duties over disbursements: this role owns accounts payable process, systems and workflow design and supervises accounts payable operations, but does not approve payment runs, which remain the responsibility of Treasury.

    • Partner with the corporate and international accounting teams to drive process improvement: map current-state processes, identify manual workarounds and control gaps, redesign the process, and deliver the system or automation change that supports it.

    • Establish and track measures of process performance, including cycle time, manual touch points and error rates, and report progress to the Vice President, Accounting.

    • Identify and eliminate low-value manual accounting effort, including recurring entries and schedules maintained below the company's materiality thresholds, and align system-driven processes with accounting policy.

    • Own the integrity of financial data flowing between operational platforms and the general ledger, including interface design, exception monitoring and validation of system-generated activity.

    • Design, document and operate the control environment over financial systems, including segregation of duties, change management and interface controls; support SOX readiness for IT general controls.

    • Review SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports for financial system vendors and service providers; evaluate complementary user entity controls, track exceptions and confirm remediation.

    • Own periodic user access reviews across financial systems, including provisioning and de-provisioning standards, certification, exception follow-up and retention of evidence for audit.

    • Own financial reporting delivery in Solution 7 and NetSuite, including report design, maintenance and the reporting calendar supporting Accounting, FP&A and executive leadership.

    • Partner with Information Technology and Information Security on system risk, data residency, access and vendor risk requirements for financial applications.

    • Own the financial systems technology and support budget, currently approximately $543,000 annually, of which roughly $493,000 is software and licence contracts across Oracle/NetSuite, Celigo, Concur and Solution 7, and the balance is offshore support; accountable for vendor selection, contracting, renewal negotiation, spend management and evaluation of new financial applications.

    • Document processes, system configurations and controls; maintain audit-ready evidence for internal and external audit.

    • Prepare analysis and written commentary supporting the Audit and Risk Committee reporting cycle on systems, automation and controls matters.

    • Provide day-to-day guidance to the accounting organization on system use; lead training, adoption and change management.

    Minimum Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems or a related field.

    • 10-15 years of progressive accounting and financial systems experience.

    • Demonstrated experience implementing or converting financial systems with accountability for delivery, covering the full lifecycle from requirements through cutover and stabilization.

    • Experience serving as the business owner, not solely the technical owner, on at least one ERP implementation or major system conversion.

    • Demonstrated project management experience running concurrent system initiatives, including scope, schedule, budget and executive stakeholder reporting; PMP or equivalent certification preferred.

    • Experience directing offshore or outsourced technical support capacity to scope, service level and budget.

    • Experience owning a software and services budget of comparable scale, including contract negotiation, renewal and vendor performance management.

    • Advanced NetSuite experience required, including saved searches, reporting and workflow configuration; Concur, Celigo, Solution 7 and Workday financial modules preferred.

    • Experience with legacy platform migrations (AS400 / IBM i or comparable) preferred.

    • Experience designing and operating IT general controls, segregation of duties and user access reviews in a financial systems environment.

    • Experience reviewing SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports and evaluating complementary user entity controls.

    • Strong working knowledge of the accounting processes these systems support: close, reconciliations, revenue, billing, accounts payable and cash.

    • Demonstrated process improvement experience, including current-state assessment, redesign and measurable reduction in manual effort or cycle time.

    • Experience owning accounts payable operations in a highly automated environment, including workflow design, exception management and vendor master governance.

    • Experience leading, developing and managing the performance of staff.

    • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; SQL or reporting tool experience preferred.

    • Strong written and verbal communication with both executive and technical audiences.

    Working conditions

    This job operates in a professional office environment or remotely. This role routinely uses general office equipment.

    Physical requirements

    • Ability to communicate clearly and exchange accurate information constantly.

    • Constantly operates computer, keyboard, phone and other general office equipment.

    • Ability to occasionally move objects up to 10 lbs.

    Direct reports

    Lead Accounts Payable Specialist. This role also directs the company's offshore financial systems support capacity, currently CW Global Partners and Vincent Cloud. Transition of the accounts payable reporting line may be staggered.

jobs.description:
Das sind Deine Aufgaben:

  • Mitarbeit an einem aktuellen Forschungsprojekt
  • Recherche in Bezug auf Schnittstellen und Standards für die Maschinendatenerfassung
  • Entwicklung einer Typisierung von Asset Administration Shells Mitarbeit an wissenschaftlichen und praxisbezogenen Veröffentlichungen
  • Pilotierung des entwickelten SchnittstellenStandards in einer realen Produktion

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du studierst (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder ähnliches
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Dich zeichnet eine selbstständige und engagierte wie sorgfältige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Programmen

Das kannst Du erwarten:

  • Einblicke in das Industrie- und Forschungsgeschäft in Zusammenarbeit mit renommierten Unternehmen und Forschungspartnerinnen und -partnern
  • interessante, anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem qualifizierten und dynamischen Team
  • die Möglichkeit zu flexibler Zeiteinteilung und eigenständigem Arbeiten
  • ein modernes, kollegiales und digitales Arbeitsumfeld
  • Raum für Kreativität und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Die Vernetzung von Maschinen untereinander und zu steuernden Systemen ist eine zentrale Aufgabe auf dem Weg zu Industrie 4.0. Die reibungslose Kommunikation ist jedoch eine Herausforderung, da Schnittstellen unzureichend standardisiert sind und die Interoperabilität nicht gegeben ist. Eine Lösung können Asset Administration Shells (AAS) sein, die eine digitale Repräsentation von Maschinen darstellen und somit die Vernetzung stark erleichtern. In deiner Abschlussarbeit wirst du anhand einer realen Produktion die Schnittstellen typisieren und auf dieser Basis systematisch eine AAS entwickeln. jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). When we’re able, we’ll have Auvik hubs in Waterloo and Barcelona for you to leverage if needed. We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

What’s this role all about?

As an Outbound SDR, you will be responsible for generating high-quality pipeline within larger MSP accounts. This is not a high-volume dialing role — it’s a strategic, research-driven outbound position focused on penetrating complex MSP organizations. You’ll partner closely with Senior and Strategic Account Executives to break into named accounts, multi-thread across technical and executive stakeholders, and create meaningful sales opportunities. If you enjoy thoughtful prospecting, personalization, and working alongside senior sellers to win complex accounts — this role is for you.

What will I be doing?

You’ll be part of our growing MSP sales motion, working remotely and collaborating directly with senior AEs and sales leadership.

You will:

  • Partner with Senior & Strategic AEs to develop outbound strategies for named MSP accounts
  • Research target MSPs (size, growth trajectory, service maturity, tech stack)
  • Identify buying signals and prioritize outreach
  • Build structured, multi-touch outreach plans tailored to each account
  • Prospect into Owners, CTOs, Directors of Operations, NOC Managers, and Service Delivery Leaders
  • Execute multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Craft tailored messaging aligned to MSP pain points (network visibility, alert fatigue, scalability, tool consolidation)
  • Book qualified meetings aligned to ICP and territory strategy
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene and detailed account notes

What are we looking for?

  • Previous outbound BDR experience (SaaS preferred)
  • Experience prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts
  • Understanding of complex buying groups and multi-threading
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High level of personalization in outreach
  • Comfortable working alongside senior sellers
  • Operates with ownership, urgency, and strategic thinking
  • Thrives in a performance-driven environment
  • Track record of generating qualified pipeline

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling into MSPs
  • Experience with network monitoring or IT tools
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC-style qualification frameworks

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.

About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

jobs.excerpt: JOB DATAJOB TITLE: QA Analyst Job Description – Quality Analyst (QA) | Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Quality Analyst (QA) with strong hands-on testing expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O).
jobs.description:
JOB DATA

JOB TITLE: QA Analyst

Job Description – Quality Analyst (QA) | Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O)

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Quality Analyst (QA) with strong hands-on testing expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O). The ideal candidate will bring 5–7 years of overall QA experience, including functional and end-to-end ERP testing, and a solid track record in test planning, execution, defect management, and test automation in RSAT. This role partners closely with business SMEs, functional consultants, developers, and release managers to ensure high-quality D365 F&O enhancements, integrations, and releases.

Key Responsibilities

1) D365 F&O Functional & Process Testing

  • Analyse business requirements/user stories and translate them into detailed test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts for D365 F&O processes.
  • Execute end-to-end testing across D365 F&O modules (as applicable), validating configurations, customisations, security roles, and business workflows.
  • Perform smoke, sanity, functional, integration, regression, and UAT support testing for releases and hotfixes.

2) Test Management, Evidence & Traceability

  • Build and maintain test plans and test suites in a test management tool such as Azure DevOps Test Plans (or equivalent), ensuring traceability from requirements → test cases → defects → closure.
  • Maintain high-quality test artefacts and execution evidence to support release readiness and auditability.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in QA documentation and test assets.

3) Defect Management & Quality Governance

  • Identify, document, prioritise, and track defects; participate in defect triage with cross-functional teams; re-test fixes and validate closure.
  • Provide clear reporting on test progress, defect trends, and release risk to stakeholders.

4) Test Automation (RSAT + other tools)

  • Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites using RSAT
  • Use Task Recorder assets to create/maintain automated business process tests.
  • Manage parameterisation via Excel parameter files and integrate executions/results with Azure DevOps.
  • Support building regression packs and execution cycles to reduce manual regression effort.

5) Collaboration & Release Support

  • Work closely with functional consultants, developers, and business users to clarify expected behaviour and validate outcomes during sprint and release cycles.
  • Support release validation activities and ensure regression coverage for periodic updates and production deployments.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–7 years of overall Quality Assurance experience, including manual and automated testing.
  • Proven experience testing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) (or Dynamics AX with strong F&O exposure).
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC/STLC, and test design techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, ALM, etc.).
  • Experience with test automation tools, including but not limited to RSAT.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and excellent written/verbal communication skills.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • RSAT implementation experience: building BPM libraries, aligning test cases in Azure DevOps, and maintaining RSAT packs for regression runs.
  • Experience testing integrations between D365 F&O and external systems (APIs, middleware, data platforms, etc.).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum ceremonies and working in sprint-based delivery.
  • Basic SQL/data validation experience for backend verification and reconciliation

General Job Requirements (Quality Analyst – Standard Expectations)

  • Ability to plan, design, and execute test plans aligned to requirements and quality standards.
  • Ability to identify, isolate, document, and track defects, and verify fixes.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to drive quality outcomes.
  • Strong documentation discipline: test evidence, release sign-offs, defect summaries, and quality metrics.
  • Proactive mindset towards continuous improvement of QA processes, templates, and automation coverage.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / Information Systems / Engineering (or equivalent practical experience).

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Director, Threat Research Engagement — ThreatLabz to join our Marketing team. This is a remote-eligible role reporting to the VP, Solutions Marketing. As the strategic voice for ThreatLabz — Zscaler's world-class threat intelligence research team — you will lead a hybrid team of technically minded creatives to set a new standard for how threat research is shared in the industry. You will translate complex threat research, telemetry insights, and security findings into compelling narratives that resonate with security leaders (CISOs), technical practitioners, information sharing organizations, and tier 1 media properties, driving global authority and market leadership.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Strategic Messaging: Develop positioning and messaging that establishes ThreatLabz as the definitive source of threat intelligence — clearly differentiating Zscaler's research capabilities and telemetry scale in a highly competitive market.
  • Launch Orchestration: Collaborate cross-functionally with the ThreatLabz research team, Product Management, Sales, Enablement, and Demand Gen to lead high-impact report launches, research releases, and threat intelligence programs.
  • Content for Every Surface: Create and commission impactful content engineered for human readers, machine ingestion, and AI-driven discovery — ensuring ThreatLabz research reaches every audience, in every format, through every channel that matters.
  • Sales Empowerment: Communicate the core value of ThreatLabz intelligence to the sales organization and develop tools that connect threat research to customer conversations, accelerating the end-to-end selling process.
  • Market Intelligence: Monitor the evolving threat landscape, track how competitors and analysts frame threat intelligence, and ensure our go-to-market strategy positions ThreatLabz as the industry benchmark for security insight.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are a relentless problem-solver who runs toward challenges with a laser focus on finding solutions that deliver the highest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team’s collective success, embracing candid feedback delivered with clarity and respect.
  • You are an active learner with a true growth mindset, constantly seeking feedback to develop yourself and support your team with purpose.
  • You are deeply customer-obsessed, building strong empathy for both internal and external stakeholders to anchor all decisions in solving real-world challenges.
  • You operate with urgency and a bias for action, demonstrating a relentless focus on execution where speed and quality work hand-in-hand.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Journalism, or a related field
  • Must be proficient in go-to-market strategy, product messaging, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling content programs or research engagement initiatives for security or SaaS audiences
  • Experience leading or building hybrid, cross-disciplinary teams

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Direct experience working with threat intelligence, security research, or incident response teams
  • Proven ability to craft messaging for both technical and executive-level audiences
  • Background in media relations, analyst relations, or thought leadership strategy tied to security research

  • Take meticulous notes and demonstrate strong reporting capabilities with an emphasis on detail
  • Open to feedback and learning the company culture

  • This role will own accountability for the specific engagements assigned
  • Support building a strong team
  • Ability to lead engagements by managing team members from various technical teams

  • Experience managing high-performance teams and/or technical implementations
  • Relevant technical and project management certifications are desirable
  • Work collaboratively with customers and self-manage through difficult situations with a focus on client satisfaction
  • Ability to multitask, balancing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to respond onsite in a 24/7/365 environment; must be willing to work evenings, overnight, weekends, and holiday hours in some cases are needed.
  • Technical and Project Management Acumen
  • Proficiency in technical writing & communication for business
  • Familiar with Agile Kanban methodology
  • Excellent Communication and Writing skills

Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is building the commercial capabilities needed to bring new therapies to patients. We’re looking for a Director of Commercial Systems to own the strategy, roadmap, and business performance of the technology supporting commercial launch and growth.

Reporting to the Vice President of Information Technology, you will lead Commercial Systems within IT. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Commercial Operations, and Market Access to translate business priorities into a coordinated roadmap, lead delivery, and ensure reliable systems and trusted data.

You will directly manage enterprise applications strategy and development and partner with IT peers, Data & Analytics, and commercial business owners. This role combines strategic leadership with accountability for delivery, reliability, launch readiness, and adoption.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own the commercial systems strategy and roadmap. Translate launch milestones and business objectives into sequenced investments, clear priorities, and measurable outcomes across CRM, commercial data, field enablement, and connected commercial platforms.
  • Establish business ownership and decision-making for commercial systems. Align stakeholders on requirements, process changes, data definitions, priorities, and acceptance criteria; resolve competing demands and escalate material tradeoffs.
  • Lead commercial systems delivery from planning through adoption. Coordinate internal teams and implementation partners, manage dependencies and risks, and hold owners accountable for milestones, quality, and operational readiness.
  • Own business requirements and service expectations for CRM and its connections to commercial data, digital engagement, and relevant ERP workflows. Partner with enterprise application owners to ensure end-to-end processes work across organizational boundaries.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics to define the commercial data and reporting capabilities needed for launch and growth, including source requirements, data quality, timeliness, and business definitions. Establish dependable access to critical information and continuity when AI interfaces are unavailable.
  • Own vendor performance, service expectations, and the commercial systems investment plan. Lead business cases, evaluate platform choices, and manage approved budgets, license utilization, and renewals with IT, Finance, Procurement, and Legal.
  • Lead launch readiness, user acceptance, training, and change management with business owners. Establish adoption measures, support coverage, escalation paths, and contingency plans before systems become business-critical.
  • Partner with IT, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Quality to incorporate access controls, data stewardship, change control, and applicable compliance requirements into commercial workflows and vendor delivery.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in commercial technology, enterprise applications, commercial operations systems, or related roles, including leadership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial operations, with a track record delivering systems for a product launch or significant commercial expansion.
  • Strong understanding of CRM, field workflows, commercial data, digital engagement, and the integrations that connect them. Experience with Veeva, Salesforce, or comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Ability to translate commercial strategy into a practical roadmap, business cases, priorities, and measurable outcomes; experience managing technology vendors and budgets.
  • Technical fluency in data flows, APIs, integration patterns, and cloud data platforms sufficient to challenge designs, assess dependencies, and guide delivery with engineering and analytics teams.
  • Experience leading requirements definition, user acceptance testing, change management, training, and transition to ongoing support.
  • Sound judgment in handling sensitive commercial and healthcare data, with experience partnering across IT, Security, Legal, Privacy, and Quality.
  • Clear communication, effective influence across functions, and a track record developing team capability and holding internal and external partners accountable.
  • Launch readiness: Critical commercial workflows are tested, supported, and ready when the business needs them.
  • Clear ownership: Decisions, priorities, and accountability are explicit; issues move to resolution without repeated executive intervention.
  • Business impact: Systems are adopted, data is trusted, and investments deliver measurable improvements in commercial execution.
  • Practical leadership and caring candor: You simplify complexity, surface risks early, challenge assumptions respectfully, and build strong delivery partnerships.
  • The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
Annualized Base Salary
$190,000—$220,000 USD

Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day.   • Knowledge of medical billing processes, claim workflows, and healthcare documentation standards
  • Strong computer proficiency, including working knowledge of MS Outlook, Word, and Excel.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, maintaining focus and productivity in a quiet workspace

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Cloud Solutions Architect in our Alliances team to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.

Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.

We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.

We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.

Location: This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.

What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical’s technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners’ teams to promote Canonical products and solutions

If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Architect role at Canonical.

What we are looking for in you

  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English

  • Continuously improve sales skills, product knowledge, and industry expertise.

Essential

  • Minimum 7 to 10 years' experience in manufacturing technology sales.

  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.

Desirable

  • Degree or relevant professional qualification.

  • Familiarity with SaaS business models and subscription-based revenue environments.

Personal Characteristics

  • A proactive, resilient, and results-oriented mindset.

  • A natural curiosity and desire to learn.

  • Strong relationship-building and networking skills.

  • Excellent listening and questioning abilities.

  • Confidence engaging with stakeholders from shop floor level through to board level.

  • High levels of professionalism, integrity, and accountability.

  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues across the business.

What Success Looks Like

  • Become recognised as a knowledgeable advisor within the manufacturing sector.

  • Contribute to Seiki's vision of becoming the leading Manufacturing Intelligence platform for precision manufacturers.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
Design Production Specialist
Location: Remote – Latin America
Eligible Countries: Colombia, Mexico, Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru, Venezuela, Uruguay, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Panama
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Manufacturing & Supply Chain / Retail Displays & Fixtures
Compensation: $8.00 – $15.00 USD/hour
English Proficiency: B2+/C1 English Required – Strong Professional Communication Skills


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based manufacturing company specializing in point-of-purchase displays and custom retail fixtures.
The company combines design, technical production, and manufacturing to transform creative concepts into functional, production-ready solutions for retail environments. The team works in a hands-on environment where design accuracy, production feasibility, visual quality, and collaboration between design and fabrication are essential.
About the Role
We are looking for a detail-oriented Design Production Specialist to prepare customer-supplied designs for final production in both 2D and 3D formats.
This role combines CAD modeling in SolidWorks with artwork preparation in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. You will ensure technical drawings, CAD models, and artwork files are accurate, properly documented, and ready for manufacturing while collaborating with production staff from design preparation through fabrication and assembly.
This opportunity is ideal for someone with a background in Industrial Design, CAD Design, Production Art, Prepress, or a related discipline who enjoys turning creative designs into production-ready files.
Why This Opportunity?
You'll combine CAD, industrial design, graphic production, and manufacturing while working on real-world physical products and custom retail environments. The role provides direct exposure to fabrication and assembly processes and an opportunity to further develop your SolidWorks and production-focused design expertise.
What You'll Do
CAD & Technical Design
  • Prepare and modify customer-supplied designs for production.
  • Create and update 2D and 3D CAD files using SolidWorks or similar CAD software.
  • Review technical drawings for accuracy and production readiness.
  • Make design adjustments based on manufacturing requirements and production feedback.
  • Maintain clear and accurate technical documentation.
Artwork & Production Files
  • Prepare and adjust artwork using Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Review graphics and artwork to ensure files are production-ready.
  • Adjust layouts, dimensions, and production files as needed.
  • Maintain consistency between artwork and technical drawings.
Production Support & Documentation
  • Collaborate with production staff throughout fabrication and assembly.
  • Respond to production feedback and make necessary design or artwork revisions.
  • Ensure design files contain the information required for successful manufacturing.
  • Manage multiple CAD, artwork, and production files while maintaining accurate version control and documentation.
  • Support Bills of Materials (BOMs) when applicable.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks or other CAD software.
  • Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop for artwork preparation and adjustments.
  • Background in Industrial Design, CAD Design, Production Art, Prepress, or a related field, through formal education or equivalent professional experience.
  • Ability to work with both 2D and 3D design files.
  • Strong attention to detail across technical drawings and graphic files.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple files, revisions, and documentation.
  • B2+/C1 English proficiency with strong written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration with U.S.-based team members.
  • Ability to communicate across departments and implement production feedback.
  • Flexible, dependable, and self-directed in a small, fast-paced remote environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with retail displays, point-of-purchase displays, store fixtures, merchandising systems, or branded environments.
  • Experience creating or organizing Bills of Materials (BOMs).
  • Previous experience as an Industrial Designer, Product Designer, CAD Designer, Prepress Technician, or Production Artist.
  • Interest in continuing to develop advanced SolidWorks skills.
How Success Is Measured
  • CAD models, drawings, and artwork files are consistently accurate and production-ready.
  • Customer designs are successfully translated into files that can be fabricated and assembled.
  • Technical drawings and graphics remain aligned throughout production.
  • Files, revisions, and documentation are organized and easy for production teams to use.
  • Production feedback and design changes are addressed accurately and efficiently.
  • Multiple projects are managed without sacrificing quality or attention to detail.
  • Communication with U.S.-based team members is clear and professional.
Why Join Us?
  • $8.00 – $15.00 USD/hour.
  • 100% remote opportunity from Latin America.
  • Work on real-world physical products and custom retail environments.
  • Combine CAD, industrial design, graphic production, and manufacturing in one role.
  • Collaborate directly with professionals involved in fabrication and assembly.
  • Develop deeper expertise in SolidWorks and production-focused design.
Important Notes
This is a production-focused design role, not a UX/UI or digital product design position. Candidates must have practical experience with CAD software and Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop and be comfortable working with both technical drawings and graphic/artwork files.
Experience with retail displays, store fixtures, or physical product manufacturing is highly valuable.
This is a remote/telecommute position.

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for sophisticated investors, financial advisory firms, and multi-family offices.

As its investment platform and partnerships expand, the company is building a scalable go-to-market engine to generate demand, strengthen its market presence, and support continued growth.

About the Role

We are looking for an Agentic GTM Lead who combines real engineering ability, commercial instinct, demand-generation experience, and financial market knowledge.

This is not a traditional marketing role, and it is not a pure engineering role.

You will build and own the systems that generate demand across outbound, content, social, SEO/GEO, email, and AI-powered automation. You will connect the technical infrastructure behind these channels with measurable commercial outcomes such as qualified interest, booked meetings, and pipeline.

Most importantly, you bring the ideas.

You will not be handed a complete GTM playbook to execute. You are expected to identify new demand-generation opportunities, launch multiple experiments simultaneously, measure what works, quickly eliminate what does not, and scale the strategies that produce results.

This is a highly autonomous, hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys moving from an idea to a working system and then proving its commercial impact with data.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to build a sophisticated GTM engine from the ground up within a growing investment management business.

You will have significant ownership over how demand is created, measured, automated, and scaled.

You will be able to:

  • Build rather than simply manage existing marketing systems

  • Experiment across multiple acquisition channels

  • Apply AI and agentic workflows to real commercial problems

  • Connect engineering directly to pipeline and revenue

  • Develop systems that automate repetitive GTM work

  • Shape the company's content, social, outbound, and digital presence

  • Work with sophisticated financial products and audiences

What You'll Do

Build and Scale the GTM Engine

  • Develop new demand-generation ideas, channels, and experiments

  • Build systems across outbound, content, social, SEO/GEO, email, and website acquisition

  • Turn successful experiments into repeatable and scalable growth systems

  • Rapidly stop or redesign initiatives that are not producing measurable results

  • Connect GTM infrastructure directly to qualified interest, meetings, pipeline, and revenue

Build Technical GTM Infrastructure

  • Work hands-on with APIs, SQL, Python and/or JavaScript

  • Build integrations between data sources, automation platforms, CRMs, and GTM systems

  • Create workflows using tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, and CRM platforms

  • Design lead enrichment, account scoring, personalization, sequencing, routing, and attribution systems

Build AI & Agentic Workflows

  • Design and deploy workflows using LLMs and AI agents

  • Automate research, content development, personalization, lead enrichment, and routing

  • Identify repetitive GTM processes that can be automated or augmented with AI

  • Build scalable systems that allow a small team to operate with significantly greater leverage

Own Demand Generation

  • Build and optimize outbound programs based on signals, data, and a clearly defined ICP

  • Develop demand through outbound, SEO/GEO, content, social, and other acquisition channels

  • Build measurable programs that generate qualified interest and booked meetings

  • Continuously test messaging, audiences, channels, landing pages, and sequences

Build the Content & Social Engine

  • Develop systems for producing and distributing podcasts, videos, webinars, social content, and thought leadership

  • Repurpose long-form content into multiple channel-specific assets

  • Build consistent visibility across platforms such as LinkedIn and X/Twitter

  • Help establish a credible voice for a sophisticated investment and wealth-management audience

Experiment & Measure

  • Run multiple experiments simultaneously rather than testing one channel at a time

  • Conduct structured A/B testing across messaging, channels, landing pages, and sequences

  • Build dashboards for demand generation, attribution, and pipeline contribution

  • Use evidence and commercial results to determine what gets scaled, changed, or eliminated

Required Qualifications

  • 4–6+ years of relevant experience across growth engineering, GTM engineering, demand generation, growth marketing, or related roles

  • Proven ability to generate original demand-generation ideas and independently turn them into experiments

  • Demonstrated demand-generation results through outbound, content, SEO/GEO, social, or similar channels

  • Ability to provide specific metrics or examples showing how your work generated leads, booked meetings, pipeline, or revenue

  • Strong hands-on engineering ability with APIs and SQL

  • Proficiency with at least one scripting language, preferably Python or JavaScript

  • Experience with automation platforms such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools

  • Hands-on experience working with CRM systems, integrations, data, and automation

  • Practical experience building with LLMs and AI/agent workflows

  • Strong commercial instinct and ability to connect technical builds to measurable business outcomes

  • Professional experience or strong working knowledge of finance, investing, asset management, or investment management

  • Strong experimentation and A/B testing mindset

  • Ability to build and own initiatives from 0 to 1

  • Strong design and UX judgment

  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-moving environment

  • Strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct professional experience in asset management or investment management

  • Experience with alternative investments and/or hedge funds

  • Strong personal or professional interest in financial markets and investing

  • Experience building a GTM, growth, or demand-generation function from scratch

  • Experience with data warehouses or analytics infrastructure such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt

  • Experience with attribution modeling

  • CFA, MBA, or other relevant finance/business education is a plus

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be based on your ability to create a measurable and scalable demand engine.

Key outcomes include:

  • Successful demand-generation experiments that can be scaled into repeatable programs

  • AI-powered and signal-based outbound systems actively generating opportunities

Why Join Us

You will join an environment where ideas are evaluated on merit, experimentation is encouraged, and ownership matters.

You will have the autonomy to determine how to reach the goal while being accountable for measurable outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who prefers building, shipping, measuring, and improving over spending months developing theoretical strategies.

Customer Success Manager (WMS/TMS)

Department: Customer Success
Reports To: Director of Account Management & Customer Success
Location: Remote – United States

About ShipHawk

ShipHawk is a leading provider of fulfillment software, helping high-volume retailers and ecommerce companies automate and optimize their warehouse and shipping operations. Our technology connects complex fulfillment workflows, giving customers greater efficiency, visibility, and control as they scale.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager who can combine strong customer relationship management with operational execution, technical curiosity, and commercial thinking.

About the Role

As a Customer Success Manager at ShipHawk, you’ll own the ongoing success and growth of a portfolio of customers using our WMS and TMS solutions.

This is not a purely relationship-focused Customer Success role. You’ll be expected to understand how your customers operate, identify opportunities to improve their use of ShipHawk, proactively solve problems, manage multiple customer initiatives, and recognize opportunities to expand our partnership through additional products, capabilities, and services.

The ideal candidate brings the organization and execution skills of a strong project manager, the customer orientation of a CSM, and the commercial instincts to identify and pursue expansion opportunities.

You’ll work closely with Account Management, Professional Services, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering to ensure customers realize measurable value from ShipHawk and continue to grow with us.

What You’ll Do

Own Customer Success & Retention

  • Serve as a strategic point of contact for a portfolio of ShipHawk customers.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s business, fulfillment operations, goals, technical environment, and growth plans.
  • Drive product adoption and help customers maximize the operational and business value they receive from ShipHawk.
  • Proactively identify customer risks, blockers, and areas of underutilization and develop clear action plans to address them.
  • Lead regular customer conversations, business reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Build strong relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day users to operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Own customer retention and proactively manage accounts toward successful renewal.

Drive Customer Growth & Expansion

Customer Success Managers at ShipHawk are expected to think commercially and identify opportunities to grow our relationships with customers.

  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs, business growth, operational challenges, and product usage.
  • Discover new use cases where ShipHawk products, features, services, or capabilities can create additional customer value.
  • Connect customer business objectives to relevant ShipHawk solutions and clearly articulate the business value of expanding the partnership.
  • Proactively introduce relevant capabilities rather than waiting for customers to ask for them.
  • Partner with Account Management on larger or more complex commercial opportunities, pricing, proposals, and contract discussions.
  • Maintain visibility into expansion opportunities and next steps within your portfolio.
  • Balance commercial growth with long-term customer trust and measurable customer outcomes.

Manage Customer Initiatives

  • Manage multiple customer initiatives and priorities simultaneously, ensuring clear ownership, timelines, action items, and follow-through.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources to move customer initiatives forward.
  • Maintain clear documentation of customer goals, open issues, commitments, decisions, and next steps.
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding actions and escalate risks before they become customer-impacting problems.
  • Develop action plans when initiatives or customer outcomes are off track.
  • Hold both internal teams and customers accountable for agreed-upon deliverables and timelines.

Become a Trusted Operational Partner

  • Develop a working understanding of warehouse, fulfillment, shipping, ecommerce, and supply chain operations.
  • Understand how ShipHawk’s WMS and TMS solutions fit into customers’ broader operational and technology ecosystems.
  • Become comfortable discussing workflows, integrations, configuration, operational processes, and technical requirements with customers and internal teams.
  • Translate technical concepts into clear business outcomes for customer stakeholders.
  • Ask thoughtful questions and diagnose the underlying business problem rather than simply responding to individual requests.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Partner closely with Account Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering.
  • Bring the right internal stakeholders into customer conversations while maintaining clear ownership of the customer relationship.
  • Surface recurring customer needs, product gaps, and operational challenges internally.
  • Provide Product and leadership with structured customer feedback and business context.
  • Help ensure customers transition successfully from implementation into ongoing Customer Success.

How We’ll Measure Success

Success in this role will include:

  • Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
  • Net Dollar Retention (NDR)
  • Customer adoption and engagement
  • Expansion opportunities identified and converted
  • Customer health and risk management
  • Successful renewals
  • Execution and follow-through on customer commitments
  • Customer satisfaction and relationship strength

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS implementation, project management, account management, or a similar customer-facing B2B SaaS role.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex customer relationships or customer projects.
  • Strong project and workload management skills with the ability to manage multiple customers, priorities, and workstreams simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to proactively identify problems, develop action plans, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills.
  • Commercial mindset and comfort identifying upsell, cross-sell, or expansion opportunities.
  • Ability to uncover customer needs and connect them to relevant products, services, or solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills and disciplined follow-through.
  • Technical curiosity and the ability to quickly learn complex software and operational workflows.
  • Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to evolve.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), ERP, OMS, ecommerce, or other operational software.
  • Experience in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, warehouse operations, or ecommerce.
  • Previous experience implementing SaaS or enterprise software.
  • Experience managing customer projects involving integrations, configuration, data, or technical workflows.
  • Experience carrying or contributing to expansion, upsell, cross-sell, renewal, or NDR targets.
  • Experience working with mid-market or enterprise customers.

Who Thrives in This Role

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Naturally take ownership rather than waiting for someone else to drive the next step.
  • Are highly organized and enjoy bringing structure to complex customer situations.
  • Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and detailed execution.
  • Are curious about how customers actually run their businesses.
  • Enjoy solving operational problems and learning technical products.
  • See commercial opportunities through the lens of customer value.
  • Are comfortable recommending additional solutions when they genuinely solve a customer problem.
  • Communicate proactively—even when the message is difficult.
  • Hold yourself and others accountable for commitments.
  • Enjoy working in an environment where you can help improve the way things are done.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based variable compensation ($85,000 - $110,000 OTE)
  • Fully remote work within the United States
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible / unlimited PTO
  • Paid company holidays
  • Wellness and lifestyle benefit
  • Professional growth and development opportunities
  • A collaborative, fast-moving environment with meaningful ownership and opportunity for career progression

Equal Employment Opportunity

ShipHawk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

Clearance

Public Trust

Overview

Ardent Eagle Solutions (AES) is seeking experienced Senior Records Managers to support a competitive federal contracting opportunity with the U.S. Department of Commerce (DOC), Economic Development Administration (EDA).

The Senior Records Manager will play a key role in assessing, redesigning, and strengthening EDA's Records Management Program to establish standardized, sustainable records and information management practices across EDA Headquarters and six regional offices.

This position will provide senior-level records management expertise with particular emphasis on digital and electronic records, records inventories and disposition, National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) requirements, process standardization, and the development of practical policies, procedures, tools, and training resources.

Background

EDA administers economic development programs and grants designed to support economic opportunities and strengthen economically distressed communities throughout the United States. Its Office of Financial and Management Services (OFMS) is responsible for planning, executing, analyzing, and strengthening EDA's records and information management functions.

EDA is undertaking an initiative to assess and modernize its Records Management Program, including records practices at Headquarters and six regional offices. The effort will address records inventories, retention and disposition, digital and email records, electronic repositories, process documentation, training, and long-term program sustainment.

Responsibilities

The Senior Records Manager is expected to:

  • Lead and facilitate the assessment, redesign, and strengthening of EDA's Records Management Program.
  • Assess existing records management practices across EDA Headquarters and regional offices and identify opportunities for standardization and improvement.
  • Review records policies, file plans, retention schedules, disposition processes, digital and electronic records practices, email and electronic message practices, and related administrative processes.
  • Plan and conduct records inventories, audits, and reconciliations, including identification of records series, owners, formats, locations, restrictions, volumes, and applicable schedules.
  • Develop recommendations and procedures for the transfer, destruction, retention, and disposition of records under Government direction.
  • Develop standardized controls for born-digital records, digitized analog records, email, electronic messages, shared drives, SharePoint, and other electronic repositories.
  • Evaluate records management practices against applicable NARA Electronic Records Management lifecycle expectations and EDA operational requirements.
  • Develop a future-state Records Management Program framework, including governance, roles, processes, repository guidance, disposition workflows, and sustainment recommendations.
  • Develop and/or oversee the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), desk guides, checklists, leadership guidance, training materials, and other practical resources.
  • Coordinate with Government stakeholders across Headquarters and regional offices to understand current practices, operational requirements, and records management needs.
  • Support project planning, workplans, risk and issue tracking, recurring status meetings, progress reporting, and transition activities.
  • Provide senior-level subject matter expertise and recommendations regarding NARA records retention policies, schedules, systems, and records management best practices.
  • Support knowledge transfer and transition activities designed to enable long-term Government ownership and sustainment of the program.

Qualifications

Approximately 6 or more years of progressively responsible experience in records management, information governance, federal records administration, or a closely related field.

  • Advanced knowledge and practical experience with NARA records retention policies, records schedules, and records management systems, as specifically identified for the Senior role in the PWS.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting records management program assessments, records inventories, audits, or disposition activities.
  • Experience developing or implementing records management policies, SOPs, file plans, desk guides, checklists, or similar program documentation.
  • Experience managing digital and electronic records, including email, electronic messages, shared repositories, or similar electronic information environments.
  • Ability to analyze existing processes, identify compliance or operational gaps, and develop practical future-state recommendations.
  • Strong written communication skills with experience developing formal reports, procedures, guidance, or executive-level materials.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to work effectively with personnel across multiple organizational levels and geographically dispersed offices.

Education

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Location and Work Hours

This position is expected to be primarily remote and may be performed from locations throughout the United States, subject to final contract requirements and Government approval.

The position will support EDA Headquarters in Washington, D.C., as well as regional operations in Philadelphia, Atlanta, Chicago, Austin, Denver, and Seattle. The PWS states that work is expected to be performed primarily remotely, with onsite support at EDA Headquarters or regional offices when authorized.

Normal work hours are expected to be Monday through Friday during standard business hours, excluding Federal holidays and Government-directed closures. Final schedules may be adjusted to align with supported EDA personnel and mission requirements.

Approximately 10% travel is anticipated based on current planning assumptions. Travel may include authorized visits to EDA Headquarters or regional offices for meetings, assessments, inventories, training, or other official program activities.

Compensation

Anticipated Salary Range: $125,000-135,000 annually

This position is being recruited in support of a competitive federal contracting opportunity, and AES is continuing to develop its staffing, labor category, and compensation strategy. Because the position is expected to support a primarily remote workforce and qualified candidates may reside in different geographic markets throughout the United States, actual compensation may vary significantly based on location, experience, education, specialized records management expertise, applicable labor category requirements, and other business and contractual considerations.

AES welcomes open and collaborative compensation discussions with interested candidates as we evaluate current market conditions and develop an accurate and competitive compensation strategy for this opportunity. The range above represents our current anticipated range and is not intended to guarantee a specific salary or compensation level.

Benefits and EEO

At Ardent Eagle Solutions, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to our employees and their families:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Coverage

  • Continuing Education Assistance
  • Paid Time Off

This job description is intended to describe the general scope of work and level of work that is needed to perform while on task with Ardent Eagle Solutions. Other duties may be assigned. Selected candidates may undergo a government security investigation and must fulfill eligibility criteria for accessing classified information. US citizenship may be a prerequisite for certain roles.

About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

The Lyra Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) program provides comprehensive DBT for adults and adolescents. Both the adult and adolescent programs involve weekly individual therapy, weekly DBT skills training groups, and weekly consultation team meetings for DBT therapists. All Lyra DBT clients also have 24/7 access to a team of licensed clinicians who have been trained in DBT skills coaching for around the clock support.

As a Lyra DBT Therapist, you’ll provide individual DBT, multifamily skills groups, and parenting and family sessions for adolescents and their parents, as well as individual DBT and DBT skills groups as needed for adult clients. You’ll also assign DBT-relevant digital lessons, videos, and assessments to your clients to enhance learnings and monitor outcomes between sessions. Lyra's clients come from a multitude of backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.

Our therapists enjoy connecting with their colleagues who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend weekly consultation team meetings as well as one-on-one consultation meetings with an expert DBT team lead, co-lead DBT skills groups with other DBT providers, and attend robust trainings to enhance your clinical skills. You always have a team behind you if a crisis comes up. You’re never alone, even while working remotely in the US.

This role may be a great fit if you are a PSYPACT authorized or PSYPACT eligible licensed psychologist with experience providing comprehensive DBT to adolescents and adults. You may also find this role rewarding if:

  • You are passionate about helping others improve their lives through skills-based interventions and work to understand your clients through a lens of compassion and curiosity.

  • Formal didactic training in DBT required (e.g., in-house training with consultation team, tape review, 1:1 supervision; Behavioral Tech; DBT Foundational Training; DBT Intensive Training; DBT for Adolescents training)

  • Available to work part-time, approximately 24 hours per week

  • Willingness and ability to work evenings and weekends to accommodate client scheduling needs

  • DBT-LBC certification preferred but not required

  • Experience, comfort, and passion working with clients who present with high risk behaviors, including suicidal ideation and/or self-injury
