Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd., is a global pharmaceutical company based in Japan with operations in the U.S. (Sumitomo Pharma America, Inc.), focused on addressing patient needs in oncology, urology, women's health, rare diseases, cell & gene therapies and CNS. With several marketed products and a diverse pipeline of early- to late-stage investigational assets, we aim to accelerate discovery, research, and development to bring novel therapies to patients sooner. For more information on SMPA, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

This position reports to the Executive Director, Data Management, Oncology and is part of the Data Management Oncology organization, which supports high-quality clinical trial execution through data oversight, risk identification, documentation, analytics, and cross-functional study support. The role is responsible for providing study-level leadership for Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) across Phase 1 to Phase 4 oncology clinical trials and works closely with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Project Teams, Quality, and other partner functions to ensure proactive risk assessment, centralized monitoring, mitigation planning, inspection readiness, and aligned execution of SMPA RBQM strategy.

Essential Functions Required for Job

  • Facilitate understanding and adoption of the SMPA RBQM strategy within Clinical Project Teams by providing targeted training, practical guidance, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Lead and facilitate cross-functional study risk assessment meetings, including planning, meeting facilitation, documentation of decisions, and follow-through on mitigation actions.
  • Own the development, maintenance, and periodic update of Risk Assessment Categorization Tools (RACTs), Quality Risk Management Plans (QRMPs), and related quality parameter documentation for assigned studies.
  • Ensure functional study plans align with approved risk assessments, Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors, protocol requirements, quality parameters, and data quality objectives.
  • Partner with Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and other functional stakeholders to define, implement, monitor, interpret, and escalate key risk indicators (KRIs), quality tolerance limits (QTLs), and centralized monitoring outputs.
  • Lead centralized monitoring activities, including ongoing data review, signal detection, trend analysis, documentation of findings, risk escalation, mitigation planning, and follow-through with accountable stakeholders.
  • Provide expert guidance on targeted source data verification (SDV) and targeted source data review (SDR) approaches based on evolving risk profiles and study-level quality signals.
  • Interpret clinical and operational datasets to identify emerging risks, quality trends, and areas requiring mitigation, escalation, or further cross-functional review.
  • Develop and deliver risk analytics, dashboards, trend summaries, and leadership-ready presentations for Clinical Project Teams and functional leadership.
  • Act as the RBQM subject matter expert within Data Management, providing consultation, standards interpretation, and practical guidance to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Support inspection readiness by ensuring RBQM rationale, review decisions, escalation records, mitigation documentation, and quality oversight outputs are complete, traceable, and defensible.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of RBQM processes, tools, templates, technology strategy, standards, and related SOP implementation across Data Management.
  • Maintain proficiency in RBQM systems, centralized monitoring platforms, data access tools, dashboards, analytics, and applicable technology used to support risk-based oversight.
  • Serve as business lead or functional representative for assigned RBQM-related technology, process improvement, or enterprise-level initiatives as needed.
  • Manage direct reports, including workload planning, prioritization, coaching, performance feedback, development planning, and support for successful execution of responsibilities.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (general & technical):

  • Strong knowledge of RBQM principles, quality risk management, centralized monitoring, clinical data review, and TransCelerate RBQM concepts including RACT and QRMP.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate risk discussions, synthesize cross-functional input, document decisions clearly, and drive alignment in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret clinical and operational data, identify meaningful trends, and translate findings into practical mitigation recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of KRIs, QTLs, CtQ factors, targeted SDV, targeted SDR, clinical trial quality oversight, and inspection readiness expectations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to develop clear documentation, dashboards, presentations, and leadership-level summaries.
  • High degree of organizational awareness, with the ability to connect related activities, understand interdependencies, and anticipate downstream impacts across study teams and functions.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Attention to detail and ability to maintain traceable, audit-ready documentation of risk assessments, quality parameters, mitigation decisions, and study-level oversight activities.
  • Ability to coach and develop team members, provide actionable feedback, and support team members in navigating priorities and cross-functional accountabilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with clinical data systems, centralized monitoring tools, reporting platforms, and data visualization tools.

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, data analytics, technology, clinical research, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry with a Bachelor’s Degree, consistent with the Associate Director job level requirement.
  • Progressive experience in clinical development, data management, clinical quality, clinical operations, RBQM, or related clinical trial oversight roles.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or leading oncology clinical trials across Phase 1 to Phase 4.
  • Hands-on experience with RBQM frameworks, including RACT and QRMP development, maintenance, governance, and cross-functional review.
  • Experience implementing or supporting centralized monitoring, KRIs, QTLs, trend analysis, risk escalation, and targeted SDV/SDR strategies.
  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits, quality reviews, or inspection readiness activities related to RBQM, clinical quality oversight, or data management.
  • Preferred qualifications include experience contributing to functional, technology, or enterprise-level RBQM initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.

  • No specific license required. RBQM, clinical quality, GCP, data analytics, or clinical research certifications or specialized training are preferred.
  • Requires ability to exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

Travel Requirements:

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Ecosystem Partnerships team builds the partner ecosystem that helps users discover, adopt, and get more value from Stripe. We work with a broad range of technology, platform, and ecosystem partners, and collaborate closely with Partner Engineering, Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams to bring Stripe’s products to market through partners.

What you’ll do

As a Partner Development Manager (PDM), you will help manage and grow a long tail of partners that make up the Stripe ecosystem. You will create and manage the programs, partner tiers, operating rhythms, and enablement needed to support partners at scale - not simply one relationship at a time.

You will help partners understand and adopt new Stripe primitives, product capabilities, and integration opportunities. You will turn partner feedback and market context into clear priorities, coordinate cross-functional work, and ensure that partner programs are effective, measurable, and easy to engage with.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building scalable programs, bringing structure to ambiguous work, and enabling many partners to succeed.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a broad portfolio of ecosystem partners through scalable programs, tiers, communications, and operating mechanisms.
  • Help design, launch, and operate partner programs that provide clear value to partners and advance Stripe’s ecosystem and product priorities.
  • Create and maintain partner tiering, engagement models, program criteria, and lifecycle motions that make it easier to prioritize support and scale partner impact.
  • Drive adoption of new Stripe primitives, product capabilities, and partner-facing initiatives across the ecosystem. Develop partner enablement plans and track adoption, engagement, and delivery against defined KPIs.
  • Work closely with Partner Engineering to surface partner integration needs, identify recurring technical or product friction, coordinate enablement, and improve the partner integration experience.
  • Work closely with Product Marketing to develop partner messaging, launches, education, and campaigns that help partners understand Stripe’s value proposition and take action.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Operations, PE&O, RPS, and other stakeholders to translate partner insights into clear workstreams, resolve blockers, and execute effectively.
  • Track partner health, program performance, commitments, and delivery milestones. Use data and qualitative feedback to identify opportunities to improve program design, partner experience, and business impact.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the ecosystem, partner objectives and constraints, Stripe’s product capabilities, and relevant market developments. Share material insights and recommendations with internal stakeholders.
  • Build productive relationships across Stripe and with partners, communicate clearly, and help align stakeholders with competing priorities around shared outcomes.
  • Contribute to an inclusive, high-performing team culture and apply Stripe’s operating principles in day-to-day work.

Who you are

You are a thoughtful, execution-oriented partnerships professional who is energized by operating at scale. You enjoy building programs, defining tiers and operating models, and improving the systems that enable many partners to succeed. You can build context quickly, turn it into clear plans, and collaborate well across functions with different goals and perspectives.

You are equally comfortable engaging partners directly and identifying patterns across a portfolio. You exercise sound judgment within established frameworks, communicate proactively, and know when to seek input or escalate.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, establish clear plans and milestones, and reliably deliver on commitments.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a demonstrated ability to build alignment with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Go-to-Market, and/or comparable functions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain product value, synthesize feedback, and keep internal and external stakeholders informed of material developments.
  • Analytical and operational rigor: comfort defining and tracking KPIs, assessing program and partner health, identifying risks or blockers, and using data and structured judgment to improve outcomes.
  • Ability to develop productive relationships with external partners and to balance partner needs with Stripe’s priorities and constraints.
  • Interest in Stripe’s products, our users, and the ecosystem in which we operate.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with ecosystem, platform, technology, payments, financial-services, or SaaS partnerships.
  • Experience driving adoption of new product capabilities, integrations, or platform primitives through partner enablement, education, or go-to-market programs.
  • Experience working closely with partner-facing engineering, product, or product-marketing teams.
  • Familiarity with partner integrations, commercial agreements, partner operations, or risk and compliance considerations in a regulated or complex environment.

  • Define and maintain our content pillars, and make sure every piece of content maps to one.
  • Build platform-native strategy per channel rather than cross-posting the same asset everywhere. Build the quarterly and monthly organic roadmap, and translate company goals into an organic plan that gets us there.
  • Broaden our content range across the education, hormone, nutrition, transformation, and empowerment angles that resonate most with a 35+ audience.

Content Calendar and Production Planning

  • Own the calendar. This is where the role has the fastest impact, and it's the first thing you'll be measured on.
  • Build and maintain a live content calendar covering filming, editing, approvals, publishing, and promotion, planned weeks ahead.
  • Block filming days with our talent in advance, get scripts reviewed and prioritized ahead of shoot days, and keep the pipeline full.
  • Plan the visual grid and content mix so every channel looks intentional.
  • Set and hold a repeatable posting cadence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Document the workflow so the system is repeatable and transferable.

Viral Concepting and Creative Direction

  • Own where ideas come from. Concepts should be sourced deliberately from trends, performance data, audience language, and our pillars.
  • Develop breakout concepts: hooks, formats, series, and trend adaptations built for reach.
  • Build and maintain a hook and concept library, and a swipe file of what's working in and outside our category.
  • Brief scripts, graphics, thumbnails, covers, and edits with clear creative direction so the output matches the intent.
  • Study our own outliers and competitors' outliers, then systematically replicate what works. You should be able to explain why a post broke out, not just that it did.
  • Set a target for outlier posts every week and be accountable to hitting it.

Deliverable and Vendor Orchestration

  • Know where everything lives. We work with an external script agency, multiple editors, a graphic designer, on-camera talent, and an ambassador roster. You are the hub making sure everything gets incorporated.
  • Manage the deliverable pipeline in ClickUp: assign, track, and close out. Nothing sits. •
  • Hold agencies, editors, and designers to deadline and quality standards, and forecast capacity so the calendar always has what it needs.
  • Route content through QC and brand review cleanly, so quality stays high and turnaround stays fast.
  • Maintain organized, accessible asset libraries. Anyone should be able to find the right asset without asking you.

Performance Ownership and Reporting

  • Own the numbers. Not as an after-the-fact report, but as the input that drives next week's plan.
  • Build and run unified channel-level reporting: growth, engagement, views, saves, shares, cadence, and outliers, booked sales calls, all in one place.
  • Own the weekly organic scorecard and report to leadership on what worked, what didn't, and what you're changing because of it.
  • Own attribution hygiene: tracking links, UTMs, bios, and descriptions, so we can tie organic directly to leads and booked calls.
  • Set CTA strategy so content drives measurable action, not just follows.
  • Identify top-performing organic assets and hand them to the paid team for repurposing, preserving social proof via post IDs.

Chat and Email Automation

Build and manage ManyChat flows tied to our keyword-trigger framework (MACROS, RECIPE, HORMONE, WORKOUT, QUIZ, and more), and coordinate with our email team's automation workflows so content, chat, and email work as one system rather than three separate ones. Own the health of these flows so they're always live and always converting.

Lead Magnet Strategy

Audit and refresh the lead magnets on warriorbabe.com/shop and roll out new ones monthly as content volume grows: PDFs, recipes, and guides pulled from what's actually resonating in the content.

Sales Cadence Coordination

Align social and chat touchpoints with our sales follow-up cadence so engagement actually converts, not just accumulates. You're measured on movement toward a sale, not just likes and follows.

Community and Engagement

Keep comments, DMs, and community response on-brand and timely, coordinating with our community lead. Surface testimonials and client wins from the community and turn them into content.

Collaboration and Partnership Management

Source and manage collaborations that grow reach: podcast guest spots for our founder, creator partnerships, cross-posts, and collab posts. Support the ambassador program with briefs, scripts, and a current content vault so ambassadors post on-brand independently.

What you bring

  • Proven organic strategy experience with numbers to back it. You have built an organic strategy from scratch or rebuilt a struggling one, and you can walk us through the before and after: follower growth, engagement, views, and ideally leads or revenue. Come ready to talk specifics.
  • You are exceptionally organized. Calendars, trackers, and documented processes are how you work, not something you'll get to later. You build systems that keep running whether or not you're in the room.
  • A track record of breakout content. You've made things that took off, and you can explain the thinking behind them. You know how to build a hook, a format, and a series, and how to spot a trend worth adapting.
  • Proven experience managing and growing a high-performing Instagram account. DTC, wellness, fitness, or coaching space strongly preferred. TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook experience strongly preferred.
  • Comfort with numbers. You can build a report, read engagement and conversion data, and use it to make decisions, not just report on it. Experience with analytics and attribution tooling is a plus.
  • Experience coordinating creative production. Briefing editors, designers, agencies, and on-camera talent, and holding deadlines across all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with ManyChat or a comparable chat-automation platform.
  • Working knowledge of email marketing/automation platforms and funnel logic. You don't need to own email, but you need to speak its language and coordinate with the team that does.
  • A real grasp of lead magnet strategy and how content, chat, and email work together to convert an audience into customers.
  • Strong writing skills and a good ear for brand voice. You can write copy that doesn't sound like AI or a corporate account: short, punchy, fifth-grade reading level, no em dashes.
  • A self-starter mentality, comfortable moving fast and owning outcomes in a small, in house team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing in the fitness/wellness/coaching space.
  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop or e-commerce-linked content.
  • Experience briefing, training, or managing ambassador or affiliate creators.
  • Experience building an in-house content function.
  • Familiarity with ClickUp, Metricool, Canva, or comparable tools.

How We'll Measure Success

  • A live content calendar built and held, with filming planned ahead and posting cadence hit consistently.

  • A consistent rate of outlier posts, and a documented reason behind each one.

jobs.description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: US, Remote - global remit
Travel: Significant domestic and international travel expected
Job ID: 1879

The Role:

IonQ is seeking a Global Alliances Lead to develop a small, carefully selected portfolio of lighthouse advisory and consulting partners, such as McKinsey, BCG, Accenture and EY. The role owns the worldwide relationship and joint business plan, with a focus on executive commitment, shared customer pursuits and measurable commercial outcomes. The role covers IonQ’s entire portfolio—compute, networking, security, sensing, space and merchant services—with focused pursuits selected to match each lighthouse partner’s capabilities and customer needs.

Our frontier technologies require partners to learn through real customer work. With selected consulting firms and systems integrators, jointly shape and co-sell quantum security and computing solutions spanning hardware deployment in customer data centers, remote cloud access, and quantum application and algorithm development, alongside quantum-safe cybersecurity assessments and migration engagements. Work with IonQ technical specialists to validate customer needs and feasible outcomes. Collaborate with regional partner leads to activate these global alliances locally, build success stories and replicate what proves effective.

Responsibilities:

Lighthouse Partner Selection & Commitment

  • Select a few priority advisory/consulting firms and practices based on customer relevance, executive sponsorship, quantum capacity and willingness to commit people and investment to joint opportunities.
  • Own global joint plans with explicit industry and regional priorities, shared customer targets, partner resources and milestones; deepen successful relationships before adding partners.

Hands-On Co-Sell and Commercialization

  • Personally engage partner practice leaders and account teams in customer discovery, opportunity qualification, business-case development and commercial pursuits. Develop a focused set of lighthouse engagements, selected for customer value and technical readiness, across quantum computing and quantum-safe cybersecurity
  • Work with Field Engineering, Partner Engineering and Platform Sales Specialists to establish feasible scope, technical success criteria, dependencies and growth milestones for all quantum engagements. Partner Engineering ensures technical alignment and integration; Field Engineering and Platform Sales Specialists support customer discovery, solution development and live pursuits across the full portfolio: compute, networking, security, sensing, space and merchant services.
  • . Build seller confidence through joint execution and evidence from customer work, creating a credible path from initial engagement to follow-on adoption.
  • Develop partner capability through joint workshops, proposals and live pursuits, supported by targeted training tied to the work at hand.
  • Teach by doing: jointly discover needs, qualify use cases, shape solutions, co-sell and deliver early engagements. Build reusable success stories and playbooks, then expand based on evidence of repeatability.

Global–Regional Opportunity Execution

  • Own the named worldwide alliance and mobilize partner headquarters, global executive sponsors, programs, practice expertise and commercial frameworks for regional quantum opportunities; regional partner leads develop local partner teams and coordinate execution in close alignment with regional sales leads.
  • With regional partner leads and regional sales leads, map named advisory/consulting accounts and local partner practices, assign pursuit responsibilities and run shared account plans, pipeline and deal reviews with agreed customer outcomes.
  • Use regional customer evidence to refine global offerings, resolve cross-region issues and bring successful approaches to additional partner practices and markets.

Commercial Governance & Replication

  • Lead alliance commercial frameworks and joint investments with Legal and Finance; maintain qualified pipeline and forecasts. Track each opportunity in one shared record with distinct global and regional contributions.
  • Secure customer-approved quantum computing and quantum-safe cybersecurity success stories and capture delivery lessons, partner economics and reusable pursuit playbooks. Work with Programs and Marketing to turn lighthouse engagement lessons into reusable tools, and GTM approaches.
  • Expand to further accounts, practices or partners when lighthouse results demonstrate customer value, partner commitment and a repeatable commercial path.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in strategic alliances, including ownership of complex relationships with advisory or consulting firms. Credibility with senior consulting practice and industry leaders; understanding of consulting economics and how to turn advisory influence into joint opportunities.
  • A proven track record of developing focused, early-stage partnerships into scalable channels that deliver sustained revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated commercial expertise in frontier technologies or an emerging technology category: translating uncertain capabilities, evolving roadmaps and customer needs into credible, staged adoption plans.
  • A record of building a small number of deep partnerships and personally co-selling early customer engagements, from discovery and qualification through solution development, negotiation and close.
  • Strong executive communication, commercial negotiation and cross-functional leadership; discipline in pipeline qualification, forecasting and investment prioritization.
  • Experience converting early customer engagements into approved references, reusable solution patterns and repeatable partner sales motions.
  • Ability to operate globally and travel; master’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Quantum experience is an advantage, including quantum computing, networking and security, space or sensing. Relevant experience may include commercialization, partnerships, customer adoption or technical solution development.
  • Experience with sovereign or regulated markets, public-sector procurement, or international trade compliance relevant to advanced technology.
  • Ability to work closely with technical specialists, distinguish validated capabilities from future potential, and establish customer success criteria without overstating readiness.

Primary Measures of Success

  • Qualified partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, closed revenue, conversion and forecast accuracy, with documented attribution and no double counting across global and regional teams.
  • Lighthouse quantum engagement progress against agreed customer outcomes: executive sponsorship, qualified opportunities, technical validation and commercial milestones for data-center hardware, remote cloud access, application and algorithm development, quantum-safe cybersecurity, quantum sensing or space opportunities with referenceability and a credible path to follow-on adoption.
  • Depth and productivity of selected partnerships: committed partner resources, active joint pursuits, time to first win and partner capability demonstrated in live engagements.
  • Evidence of replication: customer-approved success stories, reusable playbooks, follow-on opportunities and repeat wins; additional partners activated only when delivery capacity and repeatability support expansion.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, you will have secured referenceable wins from a few carefully selected local and global lighthouse partners and jointly progressed qualified customer engagements toward successful technical and commercial outcomes. You will have established an effective global–regional pursuit cadence and documented the evidence, partner capability and playbooks needed to replicate success. Expansion will follow demonstrated readiness and results. Initial lighthouse wins with consulting firms and SIs should establish referenceable quantum computing and quantum-safe cybersecurity engagements, with outcomes and playbooks that can be replicated.

jobs.excerpt: Are you passionate about being part of a team at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales that delivers extraordinary care to help individuals and businesses prepare for and protect their future?
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about being part of a team at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales that delivers extraordinary care to help individuals and businesses prepare for and protect their future? If so, then Nationwide Financial could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This Consultant, Life Underwriting opportunity sits within Nationwide’s Brokerage General Agency (BGA) area, a relationship-driven part of the life insurance business that partners closely with brokerage firms and distribution partners to support new business through the underwriting process.

In this environment, underwriters work on a broad range of life insurance cases and play an important role in evaluating risk, navigating complex case details, and helping move business efficiently from submission through decision. The work combines strong technical underwriting judgment with thoughtful communication and partnership across the case lifecycle.

What makes this team especially distinctive is the nature of the work: it is underwriting in a less automated environment, where associates are expected to think critically, apply judgment, and stay grounded in the nuance of each case rather than relying on a highly standardized process.

The role is especially attractive for underwriters who want meaningful case complexity. The team supports large and sophisticated cases, works under real volume and field pressure, and values underwriters who can balance responsiveness with sound decision-making.

Overall, this is a strong fit for candidates who are energized by challenging work, want exposure to complex brokerage-oriented underwriting, and are looking for a place where strong judgment, partnership, and long-term development are genuinely valued.

This role is open to fully remote work.

This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.

Job Description Summary

Our underwriters work hard to provide the exceptional customer experience for which Nationwide is known. Actively engaging with our firms and financial professionals to get to know their clients and their needs builds our understanding of the market, what is needed to win business and put our best offer out first.

If you thrive working autonomously, making decisions on a variety of impactful issues and continuing to learn and adapt to grow, we want to know more about you!

As a Life Underwriting Consultant, you'll analyze, select and classify applications for life insurance, of considerable technical complexity and exposure, to ensure underwriting quality according to established underwriting policies, practices and standards. You'll review and make decisions on larger, more sophisticated, or unusual business. To succeed, you'll need to coordinate life selection standards according to underwriting practices and procedures to achieve satisfactory mortality experience and acceptable administrative results. You'll have opportunities to provide leadership on projects, departmental committees and on the team by identifying problems and potential solutions and be serving as a referral point for less experienced underwriters. You'll work with latitude for independent judgment based on your underwriting authority and company underwriting standards.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Receives, evaluates and underwrites, on a medical or non-medical basis more complex applications for life insurance up to their maximum handling limit as approved by the Chief Underwriter. Protects the confidentiality of documentation and information acquired throughout the underwriting process. Works within broad limits and authority on highly sophisticated assignments requiring niche knowledge in area of expertise.

  • Maintains in-depth knowledge of manuals, underwriting materials, rules, regulations, procedures medical factors and practices impacting mortality and morbidity underwriting. Maintains solid understanding of all underwriting administrative systems to conduct business and provides outstanding service to all internal and external customers and field partners.

  • Evaluates and accesses applications requiring additional evidence of insurability. Determines the need for and authorizes the ordering of, underwriting requirements to include, but not limited to, medical examinations, blood profiles, home office specimens, attending physician reports, inspection reports, client direct interviews, and other essential information.

  • Develops a strong understanding of the accelerated underwriting process and can apply risk-based decision-making skills to determine the appropriate requirements needed to provide protective value as well as determining appropriate risk class. This may include but not limited to, making fluid-less underwriting decisions as well as the utilization of alternative sources of medical information while maintaining appropriate tolerance for accepting risk.

  • Evaluates, appraises and quantifies data derived from personal or business financial information and establishes insurable interest in keeping with the principle of indemnification. Handles complex financial underwriting applications and often assists others through referrals and training on financial underwriting.

  • Reaches terms on, coordinates, and negotiates both automatic and facultative reinsurance within the contractual terms and conditions of Nationwide's various reinsurance treaties and product and market practices.

  • Consults with other underwriters on the team and accepts referred cases when designated. Suggests innovative solutions, motivates team performance and facilitates open communication to achieve desired results. Supervises the handling of unusual or challenging cases.

  • Educates internal and external partners on underwriting process, practice and tools. Helps train less experienced underwriting staff. Coordinates, participates and leads training development and delivery for issues or initiatives requiring technical expertise.

  • Works on special projects as assigned, with little to no direction and is expected to develop project plans, requirements, timelines, etc.

  • Meets and presents with field partners as needed. Acquires input and feedback during these visits to build a better understanding of partner needs and expectations.

  • Interprets electrocardiogram tracings received as evidence for life insurance applications. Consults with Medical Director for cases where physician input is required.

  • Determines eligibility for temporary insurance and authorizes disbursement of policy refunds if the TIA is not eligible. Also authorizes reimbursement and for medical records or other fees requested as associated with requirements needed to confirm evidence of insurability.

  • Consults with Chief Underwriter, Staff Underwriting, Senior Underwriting Consultants, and the Medical Director as the need arises.

  • Supports and assists in meeting goals and objectives for varying territories, special agent programs and contests.

  • Resolves challenges with effective solutions while maintaining focus on improving time service, quality of application submissions and underwriting quality and wastage.

  • Handling up to $10,00,000 for life, up to $1,000,000 sign off for morbidity underwriting, and sign off authority for exceptions on Intelligent Underwriting.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Underwriting Manager or Director.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate studies in medical related discipline, marketing, insurance, risk management, economics, finance or business management.

License/Certification/Designation: Obtainment of AALU designation. Participation in, or attainment of, professional/technical studies or designation such as the Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU) and Fellow of Life Management Institute (FLMI). EKG Certified preferred.

Experience: Ten years life underwriting experience

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills:


Medical Underwriting: Understands the anatomy of the human body and disease processes and can assess the impact of an individual’s mortality and morbidity risk and can translate that to assess the appropriate risk classification.

Financial Underwriting: Solid foundation for sophisticated financial underwriting. Extensive knowledge of life underwriting principles and practices, including basic contract law. In-depth knowledge of anatomy, physiology, pathology, medical and non-medical risks as they relate to life insurance. Knowledge of managing and interpreting underwriting results.

Relationships: Very comfortable negotiating offers and calling out on offers that are other than applied for to explain reasons to the advisor or sales leader.

Proven knowledge of products and reinsurance - is comfortable and has relationships with our facultative reinsurance partners. Can reach terms on reinsurance decisions. Actively involved in industry meetings/conferences and our CE program. Excellent verbal and written communication skills for internal/external contacts. Strong collaboration and presentation skills in individual or group settings. Ability to make decisions on highly complex issues and work with minimal direction. Proficiency in conflict resolution. Agile and adaptable. Advanced ability to handle ambiguity in a flexible and responsive manner. Ability to coach, train and mentor other underwriters. Advanced analytical and critical thinking skills. Able to analyze highly complex insurance risks to assess acceptability including policy language, alternative rating plans, methodologies, and reinsurance. Ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence others to adopt a different point of view. Excellent judgment and creative problem-solving skills including negotiation and conflict resolution skills. Proven track record of reaching a solution in situations where there may be multiple options. Able to make difficult decisions and suggest alternative solutions. Consistently draws on appropriate perspectives and resources. Demonstrates strong resilience and supports others through change.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Exempt (Not eligible)

jobs.description:
TL;DR:

Imubit is looking for a strategic, customer-focused Solution Manager to join our Delivery team. This is a pivotal role at the intersection of industrial domain expertise, project leadership, and enterprise account management. You will serve as the primary face of Imubit to our customers — owning the success, growth, and long-term health of a portfolio of accounts across refining, petrochemical, cement, and mining industries.

If the Account Director is the "CEO" of an account, you are the "COO" — responsible for translating strategy into execution, ensuring value delivery at every stage of the customer journey, and identifying new opportunities to expand the relationship. This role is not just about delivery — it is about strategic partnership, customer retention, and revenue growth.

This job is open to remote candidates in Mexico

About us:

Imubit is redefining how industrial companies around the world adopt and scale enterprise AI, adding millions of dollars to plant bottom lines while operating safely within constraints related to energy efficiency and sustainability.

Our AI platform supports real-time optimization across complex, nonlinear industrial systems, enabling both autonomous and guided decision-making in live production environments. Fortune 500 companies rely on Imubit to continuously improve profitability and sustainability across their most valuable assets.

Backed by Insight Partners, Imubit brings together deep domain expertise from companies such as Exxon and Shell with leading AI talent from Google and other top innovators. With teams across the United States, Europe, Asia, and a growing international presence, Imubit is transforming operational optimization across industries ranging from refining and aromatics to polymers and LNG liquefaction.

In this position, you will:

Account Ownership & Customer Success

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of industrial customer accounts, spanning the full account lifecycle from new project delivery through long-term sustainment.
  • Own customer success criteria end-to-end: define them, track them, communicate progress, and drive resolution of risks and blockers.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer tactical and operational teams, leading regular project status meetings and building trusted relationships across all levels of the customer organization—from frontline operations personnel to executive leadership. Co-lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with Portfolio Managers and customer stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify detractors, document risks and challenges internally, and escalate with well-formed recommendations.
  • Support Account Directors in driving subscription renewals and expanding deals by identifying new value-generation opportunities within existing accounts.

Project Delivery Leadership

  • During the project delivery phase, lead the full project lifecycle: scope definition, requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, team coordination, milestone tracking, and successful commissioning of Imubit solutions.
  • Translate customer business needs into clear technical direction for the broader delivery team.
  • Anticipate project risks before they surface and put mitigation plans in place — keeping execution on track without sacrificing quality.
  • Plan and lead all major customer engagements: kickoffs, design reviews, commissioning sessions, and continuous improvement cycles.

Sustainment & Value Expansion

  • Once a solution is commissioned, transition the account into sustainment mode — ensuring deployed models remain evergreen, continue to generate value, and adapt as the customer's process and economic environment evolve.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve existing solutions or develop new use cases (Inferentials, DLPs, expanded optimization models) across the customer's site.
  • Collaborate with Account Directors and Business Consulting on out-of-scope opportunities that unlock additional revenue.

Technical Credibility & Communication

  • Leverage your industry engineering expertise to build credibility with plant operators, process engineers, and site leadership — positioning yourself as a knowledgeable partner, not just a vendor.
  • Communicate Imubit's technology, capabilities, and limitations in clear, audience-appropriate terms — from site-level operators to C-suite executives.
  • Train and orient customer stakeholders (operators, engineers, management) on Imubit's platform and how to extract maximum value from deployed solutions.
  • Serve as a conduit between the customer and Imubit's Product and R&D teams, channeling field insights to shape the product roadmap.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate a cross-functional delivery team (Implementation Engineers, data scientists, infrastructure) without direct management authority — earning influence through expertise and trust.
  • Partner closely with Account Directors on account strategy; collaborate with Business Consulting on expansion opportunities.
  • Share institutional knowledge across the delivery organization and contribute to the continuous improvement of Imubit's delivery methodology.

Experience & Background:

  • BSc in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5–10 years of experience in manufacturing-adjacent industries — refining, petrochemical, cement, mining, or similar industrial domains.
  • Demonstrated track record in one or more of the following: program or project management in a manufacturing or industrial setting; plant or process engineering with a customer-facing or consulting component; technical account management or customer success with industrial software or technology.
  • Experience working cross-functionally across operations, engineering, and commercial teams.
  • Comfortable presenting to and engaging with executive-level stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel 20-25% as required.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strategic Account Mindset: Ability to zoom out from day-to-day delivery and think about the long-term health, value, and growth trajectory of an account.
  • Project Leadership: Natural project management instincts — you anticipate risks, keep multiple workstreams organized, and drive execution with urgency and quality.
  • Industrial Fluency: Deep enough technical understanding of plant processes, control systems, and optimization concepts to earn the trust of engineers and operators, and to guide technical decisions in partnership with your team.
  • Customer Success Orientation: A genuine drive to help customers succeed, paired with the ability to manage expectations, handle difficult conversations, and turn skeptics into advocates.
  • Influence Without Authority: Skilled at aligning diverse stakeholders — both internally and externally — toward a shared outcome, without relying on a command-and-control structure.
  • Executive Communication: Clear, concise, and confident communicator in both written and verbal formats, able to adapt your message to your audience.
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about learning new technologies and domains at pace. Imubit operates at the frontier — you need to be comfortable with ambiguity and constant evolution.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with process control, planning and economics, or plant optimization solutions.
  • Background in a customer-facing vendor or consulting role serving industrial clients.
  • Familiarity with AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics applied to industrial processes.
  • Experience with subscription-based SaaS delivery models and recurring revenue dynamics.

In addition to federal law requirements, Imubit complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

About Job

Role: Senior Applied Reinforcement Learning Engineer

Location: Palo Alto, CA or Seattle, WA (Hybrid/Remote)

About the Team

Centific AI Research advances foundational AI models and applications through reinforcement learning, alignment, and human-centered intelligence. Our mission is to transform data, signals, and human insight into next-generation intelligent systems that redefine enterprise intelligence.

We're building a governed RL environment platform that enables enterprises to safely iterate and improve AI agent workflows through simulation-based learning, bridging human-labeled signal creation with automated RL training for high-stakes operations.

Role Overview

As an Applied RL Engineer, you will design and build RL environments that simulate complex enterprise workflows and train intelligent agents within them. You'll work at the intersection of RL research and production systems, translating customer requirements into bespoke simulation environments and post-training pipelines that deliver measurable improvements to AI agent performance.

This role requires deep expertise in both classical RL methodologies and modern LLM-based agent architectures. You'll shape our product direction and help make RL accessible to enterprise customers who need safe, compliant ways to improve their AI systems.

Core RL Competencies

Foundational RL

  • MDPs & value methods: State/action spaces, Q-learning, DQN, Double DQN, Dueling DQN
  • Policy gradient methods: REINFORCE, Actor-Critic, A2C/A3C, variance reduction
  • Advanced optimization: PPO, TRPO, SAC, trust regions, entropy regularization
  • TD learning: TD(0), TD(λ), eligibility traces, bootstrapping methods
    •

LLM Alignment & Post-Training

  • RLHF pipelines: Reward model training, preference learning, human feedback integration
  • Direct optimization: DPO, IPO, KTO, offline preference optimization
  • Group-based methods: GRPO, RLOO, sample-efficient policy improvement
  • Reward modeling: Bradley-Terry models, reward hacking mitigation, KL constraints
    •

Environment Design

  • Gymnasium/OpenAI Gym: Custom environments, observation/action spaces, wrapper patterns
  • Reward engineering: Sparse vs. dense rewards, potential-based shaping, intrinsic motivation
  • Verifier design: Programmatic reward functions, outcome verification, ground-truth evaluation
  • Simulation: Sim-to-real transfer, domain randomization, multi-agent dynamics
    •

Advanced Techniques

  • Offline RL: CQL, BCQ, IQL for learning from fixed datasets without environment interaction
  • Model-based RL: World models, Dreamer, MuZero, learned dynamics
  • Hierarchical RL: Options framework, goal-conditioned policies, temporal abstraction
  • Imitation & exploration: Behavioral cloning, GAIL, curiosity-driven exploration, UCB
    •

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build custom RL environments (digital twins) simulating enterprise workflows: document processing, compliance, onboarding, support automation
  • Post-train LLM-based agents on domain-specific tasks using PPO, GRPO, DPO, and RLHF
  • Build end-to-end pipelines converting human-labeled traces into RL training data
  • Architect multi-step reasoning agents with tool-calling and closed learning loops
  • Design reward functions, verifiers, and validation frameworks for pre-deployment testing
  • Translate cutting-edge RL research into production systems; contribute to publications
    •

Required Qualifications

  • Deep RL expertise: 3+ years hands-on experience with environment design, reward engineering, policy optimization
  • LLM post-training: Experience fine-tuning LLMs using RLHF, DPO, PPO, or similar
  • Production skills: Software engineering beyond research with scalable pipelines and training infrastructure
  • Agentic AI: Experience with LLM-based agents, tool use, multi-step reasoning
  • Technical stack: Strong Python; Gymnasium, RLlib, Stable Baselines; PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow
  • Education: MS/PhD in CS, ML, or related field (or equivalent experience)
    •

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, or similar venues
  • Enterprise workflow experience in healthcare, finance, logistics, or compliance
  • Open-source contributions to CleanRL, TRL, veRL, or agent frameworks
  • Experience with world models, synthetic data generation, and simulation
  • Distributed training and large-scale RL experimentation
    •

Why Join Centific

  • Lead the frontier: Shape a new discipline at the intersection of RL, simulation, and enterprise AI
  • Ship your science: See your research power real systems across healthcare, finance, and safety
  • Collaborate with leaders: Work alongside NVIDIA, Microsoft, and the global AI community
  • Build what matters: Create governed, compliant AI systems enterprises can trust.

In the time it takes you to read this job description, RapidSOS will have handled ~1,380 emergencies.

At RapidSOS, we are committed to using technology to build a safer, stronger future and working together to save lives. We’re in an exciting phase of growth, welcoming new members from across the globe to our mission-driven, ambitious, and inclusive team. Our work is founded on our values of trust and safety, pioneering, urgency, and purpose over pride, all of which support a company culture where people can innovate, collaborate, grow, and, above all, make an impact. If that sounds like an exciting opportunity, we want to hear from you!

RapidSOS is ​​the leading public safety AI company that unlocks mission-critical intelligence for first responders and security teams – enabling faster, smarter and more accurate emergency response. Real-time data from the world’s largest safety network of 700M+ devices, 200+ global enterprises, and 23,000+ federal, state and local agencies fuels the RapidSOS HARMONY AI engine that delivers this intelligence to those who need it most. Learn more at www.RapidSOS.com.

What this role is about:

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between product innovation and customer needs to deliver impactful solutions? At RapidSOS, we’re transforming public safety with AI-driven technology that empowers first responders and 911 telecommunicators to save lives and improve outcomes in emergencies.

We’re seeking a SeniorProduct Marketing Manager to define and execute marketing strategies that connect our innovative technology with the evolving needs of public safety professionals. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of product, sales, and the field to create impactful messaging, drive go-to-market initiatives, and ensure our solutions resonate with the needs of the public safety community. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our products and users, craft compelling content for our field teams, and foster cross-functional alignment to deliver clear and effective messaging. If you thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, enjoy working collaboratively to deliver innovative solutions that save lives, and are excited about translating technical capabilities into real-world impact, this is the opportunity to make a tangible difference where every second matters!

What you’ll do:

Go-to-Market Execution

  • Define and execute go-to-market strategies for our public safety and enterprise software products.
  • Develop positioning and messaging that resonate with public safety or enterprise professionals, emphasizing product value and differentiation.
  • Track the competitive landscape and maintain a current point of view on how RapidSOS differentiates, translating that into positioning guidance the field can actually use in a sales conversation.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to understand product functionality and translate product functionality into field-ready language. Build the AI-assisted content workflows that keep that translation current as the product evolves.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to align product messaging and field enablement efforts.
  • Act as the voice of the customer within RapidSOS, advocating for public safety’s needs in product and marketing discussions.
  • Influence product roadmap and marketing priorities by bringing a clear, evidence-backed point of view on what target customers and prospects need.
  • Develop and evangelize AI workflows, prompt libraries, and content templates that expand what the broader PMM and GTM team can produce independently, reducing bottlenecks and raising the floor on output quality across the org

Field Enablement

  • Create and deliver training materials, sales enablement collateral, and messaging frameworks to empower Sales and Customer Success teams, using AI-assisted workflows that reduce time-to-first-draft and keep materials current as messaging evolves.
  • Support field teams with impactful storytelling, ensuring they are equipped to communicate the value of RapidSOS solutions to public safety audiences.

Insights & Feedback Loops

  • Gather and analyze quantitative and qualitative feedback from the field, customers, and public safety stakeholders to inform product and marketing strategies, leveraging AI workflows to make processes more repeatable.
  • Continuously refine product messaging and positioning based on data insights and real-world feedback.

This role covers the full scope of product marketing at RapidSOS. In practice, ownership will be divided across audiences and workstreams as the team grows, but the ideal candidate is someone who can operate across all of it and help us figure out where to specialize.

What we’re looking for in our ideal candidate:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in marketing or product roles, including a minimum of 4 years with responsibilities in product marketing in B2B SaaS or B2G environments.
  • Builder Mentality: You have a bias for action and have built a thing, not just contributed to it. Content libraries, launch checklists, messaging systems, RFP templates. You've created infrastructure that other people rely on after you've moved on to the next problem.
  • Execution discipline: You produce field-ready work under pressure, without waiting for perfect information or a fully staffed team. Ambiguity doesn't stall you.
  • AI fluency: You're already using AI tools to do real work — writing first drafts, building prompt libraries, systematizing content production. You have saved workflows and templates you built yourself, and you're looking for a place to take that further.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal instincts, externally and internally. You keep projects structured, stakeholders informed, and know when to escalate rather than absorb.
  • Cross-functional Influence: You've sat in enough sales calls and product reviews to translate in both directions, and both sides trust you because of it. When messaging is drifting or a launch isn't ready, you say so and make it stick.
  • Data-Driven: You know which numbers actually matter and which ones just look good in a slide. You use customer data, field feedback, and sales signals to build a case and know when the data is telling you to change course.
  • Technical Understanding: Comfortable going deep with Product and Engineering, and equally comfortable pulling back to write something a skeptical, time-pressed buyer will actually finish reading.

Travel: Ability and willingness for occasional travel (<10%)

Nice-to-have experience (but not required!):

  • Experience with Salesforce and Hubspot.
  • Experience producing product-focused content for trade shows or industry conferences, where the audience is skeptical and the window is short.
  • Experience with a wide audience range. You've written for and presented to meaningfully different audiences (front-line staff, executives, technical teams, etc.) and know how to adjust your approach for each.

What we offer:

  • The chance to work with a passionate team on solving one of the largest challenges globally
  • Competitive salary and benefits and equity participation
  • A dynamic, flexible and fun start-up work environment with a highly talented team

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Supply Planning Analyst will assist the supply planning function for RealTruck.The primary purpose of this role will be to develop, deploy, implement, and lead best-in-class Supply Planning and Inventory Management processes, including network wide capacity management, production scheduling, and inventory management.

CORE FUNCTIONS

  • Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Supply Planning processes and procedures within the RealTruck S&OP process.
  • Develop and maintain rough-cut capacity planning and network capacity analyses at the value stream, plant, and subgroup levels to identify constraints, capacity gaps, and opportunities to align supply with demand.
  • Analyze and refresh, on an as needed basis, manufacturing value streams and manufacturing flow based on demand characteristics.
  • Support the production planning and scheduling process by analyzing production requirements, inventory positions, capacity constraints, and demand priorities. Participate in recurring production and supply planning reviews, highlighting risks, deviations from plan, and potential solutions.
  • Develop, maintain, and analyze Supply Chain dashboards and key performance indicators (KPIs), including Schedule Adherence/Attainment, On-Time Delivery (OTD), Fill Rate, inventory levels, days of supply, and other relevant planning metrics.
  • Analyze planning rates and assumptions, including hours per unit (HPU), production rates, efficiencies, and demonstrated versus planned capacity, and recommend updates where appropriate.
  • Develop and maintain statistical inventory models (model stock) to set target finish good and raw material inventory levels.
  • Support the development and maintenance of finished goods and component inventory policies, including safety stock levels, stocking strategies, replenishment parameters, economic order quantities, and Kanban sizing.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to investigate supply, inventory, and capacity issues and provide data-driven recommendations to support business decisions.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Finance, Economics, or a similarly analytical discipline is required.
  • 2-5+ years of related experience in Supply Chain or Operational Finance required.
  • Expertise in Demand Planning/Supply Planning.

Required Licenses

·None.

Skills, Abilities, and Knowledge

  • Versed with best-in-class ERP/MRP systems (use, calibration, setting of parameters) and other useful platforms (Excel, Access).
  • Ability to effectively present information to top management.
  • Ability to analyze and communicate numerical data utilizing analysis capabilities.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with manufacturing, sales and finance.

Travel

  • Occasional travel may be required.

COMPETENCIES

  • – Synthesizes complex or diverse information; Collects and researches data; Uses intuition and experience to complement data; Designs workflows and procedures.
  • – Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.
  • – Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.
  • – Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.
  • – Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.
  • – Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to other views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Supports everyone’s efforts to succeed.
  • – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings.
  • – Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

SUPERVISOR RESPONSIBILITIES

·Individual Contributor

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • This position is subject to Sedentary Work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involved sitting most of the time. Walking and standing are required only occasionally.

Physical Activities

  • This position is subject to the following physical activities: talking and hearing.

Visual Acuity

  • The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; expansive reading; visual inspection involving small defects, small parts and/or operation of machines (including inspection); using measurement devices; and/or assembly of fabrication of parts at distances close to the eyes.

Working Conditions

  • This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment.

Perks That Go the Extra Mile :

At RealTruck, we take care of our people—because they drive our success. Enjoy great benefits like medical, dental, and vision coverage, company-paid life insurance and disability, and a 401(k) with company match (eligible the first of the month after you start). Need balance? We’ve got wellbeing days and parental leave. Want to grow? Take advantage of educational reimbursement. Plus, earn referral bonuses and score exclusive employee discounts on RealTruck products. Great benefits. Great people. Even better careers.

RealTruck is the premier manufacturer and digital destination of accessories for truck, Jeep®, Bronco® and off-road enthusiasts around the world. Globally headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan, RealTruck’s 6,000+ associates operate from 35+ facilities across four continents. RealTruck’s industry leading product portfolio, which includes the Husky Liners total vehicle protection brand, boasts over 1,000 patents and pending applications. The company’s omni-channel retail approach delivers a seamless consumer experience online at RealTruck.com, as well as through its 12,000+ dealer network and automotive (OEM) partnerships.

Sobre a Zippi

Estamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.
Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito, permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa consistente para suas operações.
Desde o nosso lançamento, há quatro anos, alcançamos a lucratividade e vivemos um período de crescimento exponencial. Até hoje, já concedemos mais de R$ 10 bilhões em crédito para micro e pequenos negócios em todo o Brasil. Estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de capital de giro no mercado brasileiro de MPBs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 3,5 trilhões por ano. Assim como os cartões de crédito transformaram o consumo, a Zippi está redefinindo a forma como os pequenos negócios gerenciam seu fluxo de caixa — com acesso instantâneo, integração fluida e soluções construídas para necessidades reais do dia a dia.
Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma abordagem altamente automatizada e baseada em dados. Construímos uma infraestrutura tecnológica avançada, capaz de processar grandes volumes de dados de pagamentos e crédito, o que nos permite realizar a análise de risco, a liberação e a cobrança de crédito em escala, mantendo unit economics sólidos. Gerenciamos todo o ciclo de crédito internamente, alavancando ciência de dados de ponta para tomar decisões em tempo real com alto nível de precisão.
Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, formamos um time de tecnologia de calibre global focado em construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar. Se você busca a oportunidade de gerar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena, em uma das startups que mais crescem em mercados emergentes, atuando em uma oportunidade multibilionária — a Zippi é o lugar certo para você.

Somos um time coeso e de alta performance sempre com foco em entregar valor para os nossos clientes. Aqui, as pessoas engenheiras possuem um papel estratégico, participando de projetos de alto impacto, focando na geração de valor do produto e na entrega de soluções sustentáveis.
Em parceria direta com produto, design, dados e demais áreas de negócio, garantindo que as pessoas engenheiras tenham contexto amplo para tomar decisões que geram valor real para o negócio da Zippi.

Sua Missão

Na Zippi, sua missão será atuar junto aos times de produto, design, dados e demais áreas de negócio para transformar insights de mercado e necessidades dos nossos usuários em soluções tecnológicas de ponta. Você deverá:

  • Priorizar entregas de forma orientada a resultados, equilibrando velocidade e qualidade; medir o impacto das suas entregas por meio de métricas claras (retenção, conversão, satisfação).
  • Assumir a liderança técnica de projetos de alto impacto, propondo soluções criativas, resilientes e escaláveis no longo prazo.
  • Trabalhar de ponta a ponta: do desenho de protótipos à instrumentação em produção, passando por testes automatizados e ajustes rápidos próprios de um ambiente ágil.

Por que vir para a Zippi?

jobs.excerpt: We're seeking an AI Modernization Manager to join us at Space Inch.
jobs.description:
We're seeking an AI Modernization Manager to join us at Space Inch. You'll be embedded with one of our longtime clients - a fast-growing platform in the payments and commerce space serving thousands of merchants across physical and digital gift card programs. As the client has scaled, critical business logic has grown outside their core platform: undocumented legacy applications, scripts, and manual processes that keep the business running but that aren’t documentation. This role owns discovery, planning, and coordination for the resulting modernization program, turning that hidden estate into a roadmap engineering can build against. AI is expected to be a big part of how you work day to day, not just for individual tasks but to build workflows the wider team can reuse for discovery, documentation, planning, and risk tracking.

Our Mission, Vision, and Values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

Working at Space Inch

  • Our team is around 80+ people, primarily based in Croatia, but also members in the rest of the Europe, South America, and the US; the product team mostly being in the US, and engineering in Croatia and Brazil
  • We are remote-first, but occasional travel may be required, e.g. for annual company retreats
  • We work on end-to-end projects with a long-term vision
  • We strongly support work-life balance for our team members, even though we work in different time zones

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, technical discovery, systems analysis, legacy modernization, or similar hybrid technical/delivery role - with product management experience a must-have within that mix
  • Experience with application architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, reporting, scheduled jobs, and both cloud and on-prem infrastructure
  • Proven ability to dig into an unfamiliar, poorly documented system - reading code, interviewing stakeholders, and reconstructing context that was never written down, without waiting for someone to hand you a process
  • Ability to turn business and operational needs into requirements and plans that engineering can build against (i.e. architecture diagrams, runbooks, and monitoring/support handoff documentation)
  • Understanding of the software delivery, release management, observability, support, and operational handover well enough to hold engineering accountable to it
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience operating at the intersection of engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners
  • Readiness to push on missing information or challenging assumptions
  • Hands-on experience using AI for investigation, analysis, documentation, or workflow improvement - not just familiarity with the idea
  • Ability to read .NET code and architecture to evaluate designs, ask sharp questions, and sanity-check what engineering delivers, even though you won't be writing production code in this role

Bonus points

  • Experience with transaction systems or reporting platforms
  • Experience with Windows-based legacy applications and hybrid (cloud + on-prem) infrastructure
  • Experience working with or managing relationships with a managed service provider (MSP)

What You'll Do

  • Technical and business discovery: Investigate legacy applications, scripts, and manual processes to understand what they do, why they exist, and what depends on them. Document how these systems actually behave and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Modernization planning: Decide whether each capability should be kept, replaced, consolidated, automated, or retired, and turn that into a prioritized roadmap. Keep the roadmap current against real business priorities and deadlines.
  • Delivery and stakeholder coordination: Coordinate initiatives from discovery through release and handover. Work across engineering, QA, Operations, business stakeholders, the MSP, and outside partners.
  • Operational readiness and risk management: Ensure everything that ships has requirements, documentation, monitoring, and an owner behind it. Track material risks to resolution.
  • Continuous improvement and AI-enabled workflows: Turn recurring manual work across discovery, planning, development, QA, release, and maintenance, into templates and reusable AI-assisted workflows for discovery, documentation, and risk tracking.

Qualities for Success

  • Proactive investigator: You dig in and pull information out of both people and systems, and keep asking questions until undocumented context is actually reconstructed.
  • Decisive planner: You can look at a messy capability and make (and defend) a real keep/replace/consolidate/retire call.
  • Documentation-minded by default: Diagrams, runbooks, and written context aren't extra steps for you, they're part of how you think through a problem.
  • Cross-functional communicator: Equally credible talking to an engineer about architecture and a business stakeholder about impact and timeline.
  • AI-fluent, not AI-dependent: You build reusable AI workflows for discovery and documentation, but you verify what AI gives you against real sources.

Where You’ve Likely Developed These Skills

  • Technical product management, systems analysis, or legacy modernization roles inside complex, legacy-heavy environments (e.g., fintech, payments, retail tech, or platforms going through modernization)
  • Roles that required you to reverse-engineer systems with little or no documentation
  • Consulting, agency, or professional services backgrounds where you had to build trust with a client's internal teams quickly

You're a Great Fit If You

  • Genuinely enjoy the "detective work" of figuring out how something actually functions, not just reading the ticket about it
  • Already use AI as part of how you investigate, document, and plan - and want to build that into repeatable team workflows
  • Are comfortable challenging and verifying technical outcomes without being the one who designs or builds them

This Role is Not a Fit If You

  • Prefer working from a fully specified backlog rather than building the picture yourself
  • Are uncomfortable reading code or working directly with technical systems
  • Have only surface familiarity with AI tools rather than real, hands-on use for investigation or documentation work

Compensation and Benefits

  • Compensation: $4.500,00 – $5.500/monthly for a B2B engagement, based on experience and skills
  • Remote-first setup
  • Health & Wellbeing: 100% paid sick leave + annual health checkup
  • Stay active: Wellness subsidy
  • Continuous Growth: An education budget specifically designed to fuel your learning and help you expand your knowledge base.
  • Extra perks: Referral bonus
