This position is remote

The position will be responsible for the following but not limited too:

Test Automation Development & Execution

  • Develop, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for unit, integration, and end-to-end functional testing in accordance with Agile sprint schedules and program quality standards.
  • Ensure all automated test cases are executable by the end of each Agile sprint and delivered for incorporation into the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline.
  • Support the program's Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology by writing test cases prior to code development in collaboration with software developers.
  • Analyze the current state of test automation coverage and contribute to the Test Automation State Assessment Report and corresponding automation completion project plan.
  • Automate adjacent legacy test cases per Government-approved schedule to expand overall regression test coverage across the DEERS application portfolio.

Test Planning & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) at the end of each development cycle/sprint, demonstrating complete testing coverage of all requirements.
  • Assist in the preparation of UAT plans, test scenarios, and test scripts for Government and external partner acceptance testing activities.
  • Document all test activities, test case results, and defect findings within the Government-provided Test Case Management System.
  • Contribute to the preparation of Testing Reports, Release Notes, and Software Version Descriptions (SVDs) per release cadence requirements.

Quality Assurance & Defect Management

  • Participate in mandatory code reviews at three checkpoints: 50%, 75%, and 90% of development completion, ensuring conformance to quality standards.
  • Monitor and enforce hard quality thresholds.
  • Triage and track defects in JIRA; conduct analysis, determine if issues were previously identified, and attempt error replication prior to escalation to product teams.
  • Submit JIRA tickets prior to product team escalation; support weekly defect escalation reporting and report escalations to customers and the Government Product Owner at minimum weekly.

Security & Compliance Testing

  • Assist in ensuring code scan results are reviewed and documented prior to each production release, when rule packs/STIGs change, and on an as-needed basis.

Section 508 / Accessibility Testing

  • Conduct accessibility testing against WCAG 2.0 Level AA standards at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Assist in the preparation of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) including test results, remediation reports, and documentation of conformance levels for applicable deliverables.
  • Conduct Section 508 compliance testing and support reporting status to the Monthly Status Report (MSR).

Performance & Environment Testing

  • Support stress and load testing activities conducted in the ProdSim (Production Simulation) environment.
  • Assist in coordinating and supporting Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities in collaboration with the technical and operations teams.
  • Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) of all application changes in the UAT environment prior to production deployment.

Agile / DevSecOps Participation

  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Maintain and update sprint-level defect tracking, test case completion status, and burn-down metrics in JIRA.
  • Adhere to the full deployment pipeline standards and quality gates at each stage.
  • Contribute QA metrics and status to the Monthly Quality Status Report (QSR)

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 2 years with BS/BA; 0 years with MS/MA; 6 years with HS diploma
  • Obtain and maintain public trust clearance
  • IAM/IAT Level II certification (CompTIA Security+, System Security certified Practitioner (SSCP), CompTIA CySA+ or GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
  • Experience in software quality assurance, test automation, or software testing roles.
  • Foundational understanding of test automation principles and experience writing automated test scripts in at least one automation framework or scripting language (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Python, Java, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies and DevSecOps principles.
  • Basic experience with defect tracking tools, preferably JIRA.
  • Understanding of software testing lifecycle including unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and ability to document test results clearly and accurately.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment and communicate effectively with developers, leads, and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) Foundation Level certification or equivalent.

Job Description

Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a AgriSompo Senior Claims Auditor II in our AgriSompo National Operations team.

As a Senior Crop Insurance Claims Auditor, you will deliver exceptional customer service to agents and producers by accurately and efficiently reviewing and processing medium to complex crop insurance claim files. You will serve as a subject matter expert in at least one area of claims auditing, providing guidance and expertise to support colleagues and ensure consistency and quality across all audit activities.

Location: This position will be remote and may be based in any of the following states: Kansas, Iowa, Montana, Missouri, North Dakota, South Dakota, Minnesota, Colorado, or Nebraska. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environmentwhere our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and general technical/computer systems.

  • Effective interpersonal, oral, written, and communication skills with the ability to interact with internal and external customers.

​

jobs.title: Legal Client Services & Intake Specialist
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an experienced client services professional to become the first point of contact for a small real estate law firm.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced client services professional to become the first point of contact for a small real estate law firm.

This is a combination of legal receptionist, client intake and client relations.

The main goal is to take calls and enquiries away from the attorney, properly understand what the person needs, and decide what should happen next.

You'll need to learn the firm's services, the types of matters it handles and the types of work it doesn't take on. You'll also need to understand when a potential client should be referred to another attorney or professional.

There is also an opportunity to help build a proper intake process for the firm. The current system isn't as structured as it needs to be, so someone who can improve the process and eventually help manage it will have plenty of scope to grow.

What You'll Be Doing

Client Intake

  • Answer incoming calls and enquiries
  • Speak with prospective clients and understand what they need
  • Ask the right questions to properly qualify enquiries
  • Determine whether the firm's services are appropriate
  • Collect relevant information from prospective clients
  • Record and organise intake information
  • Schedule consultations and follow-up calls
  • Pass qualified matters to the attorney when appropriate
  • Refer unsuitable enquiries to the appropriate attorney or professional

Client Relations

You'll also work with existing clients and referral partners.

This includes:

  • Answering client questions where appropriate
  • Following up with existing clients
  • Keeping clients updated
  • Making sure clients know what happens next
  • Building good relationships with referral partners
  • Checking in with clients to understand how things are going
  • Identifying areas where the client experience could be improved
  • Escalating issues that genuinely require the attorney's attention

The aim is for clients to feel that they are speaking with someone who knows the firm and can actually help them, rather than simply someone answering the phone.

Building the Intake Process

The current intake process needs to be developed and properly structured.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:

  • Help design a clear intake process
  • Build systems for handling new enquiries
  • Create procedures and checklists
  • Improve how information is collected
  • Document the firm's intake procedures
  • Identify gaps in the current process
  • Help train future junior team members
  • Eventually take ownership of the intake function

This means the role could grow considerably for the right person.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience in a law firm is strongly preferred, particularly experience with:

  • Legal intake
  • Legal reception
  • Client onboarding
  • Law firm administration
  • Client services
  • Lead qualification
  • Scheduling consultations
  • Managing incoming enquiries

You should be comfortable speaking to people on the phone and asking questions rather than simply taking messages.

Experience with real estate law would be particularly useful, although a strong legal intake background in another area could also work.

Personality Matters

Confidence is important for this role.

You'll be speaking with potential clients, existing clients and referral partners, so you need to be friendly and professional while being comfortable taking control of a conversation.

The right person will be:

  • Confident on the phone
  • Friendly and approachable
  • Professional
  • A good listener
  • Comfortable asking questions
  • Intelligent and curious
  • Calm when they don't immediately know the answer
  • Good at thinking on their feet
  • Comfortable learning a new area of law
  • Able to make sensible decisions about what needs to be escalated

You don't need to know everything on day one. You do need to be willing to learn the business properly and become confident enough to handle conversations without immediately passing everything to the attorney.

What Success Looks Like

The goal is for the attorney to stop having to personally screen every incoming call.

Over time, you should become the person who can:

Answer → Understand → Qualify → Guide → Schedule or Refer

You'll also help build the systems behind this process so that the firm can eventually bring additional junior staff into the intake function.

Systems

The firm currently uses:

  • Clio
  • HubSpot
  • QuickBooks Online
  • Microsoft Teams
  • OneDrive

Experience with Clio would be particularly useful, although training can be provided to someone with the right background.

Growth

There is a clear opportunity for this role to grow.

Someone who can build and manage the intake process could eventually take responsibility for the function, help bring on junior team members and take on additional hours and responsibilities as the firm grows.

jobs.description:
Deliver outcomes that matter. Help organizations improve safety, sustainability, quality, and operational performance.

At Intelex, we help organizations manage Environmental, Health, Safety, Quality (EHSQ), Sustainability, and ESG programs through a powerful cloud-based platform designed to improve compliance, reduce risk, and drive operational excellence. Our customers rely on Intelex to transform complex business requirements into scalable solutions that deliver measurable business results.

As a Project Manager within Implementation Services, you will lead SaaS implementation projects from initiation through go-live, helping customers successfully adopt and realise value from the Intelex platform. While Project Managers at Intelex support a wide range of solution areas, this role will primarily focus on Environmental and Sustainability implementations, while also supporting broader EHSQ and enterprise software projects as business needs evolve.

Success in this role is driven first by strong project delivery, stakeholder management, and customer leadership skills. Experience in Environmental, Sustainability, ESG, or EHSQ programmes is advantageous but not required.

This role is ideal for a Project Manager who thrives in customer-facing environments, enjoys solving complex business challenges, and is passionate about delivering predictable outcomes while building strong customer relationships.

Why This Role Matters

Intelex customers rely on successful implementations to achieve outcomes across environmental management, sustainability reporting, health and safety, quality management, operational risk, and regulatory compliance initiatives. Project Managers play a critical role in helping customers navigate complex transformation programmes while ensuring projects remain aligned to business goals and delivery commitments.

As a Project Manager, you will provide the structure, leadership, and accountability needed to guide customers from project kickoff through go-live. Your ability to align stakeholders, manage risks, and drive execution will directly contribute to successful customer outcomes.

What You'll Do

Lead Implementation Delivery from Start to Finish

  • Own and drive SaaS implementation projects through the full project lifecycle, from project kickoff through go-live and transition to Customer Success.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, and governance structures.
  • Ensure project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria remain aligned throughout delivery.
  • Actively manage project financials, risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests.

Partner with Customers to Achieve Business Outcomes

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for project delivery.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including business and technical leaders.
  • Facilitate project meetings, workshops, steering committees, and executive status discussions.
  • Ensure customers remain informed, engaged, and confident throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Coordinate activities across consultants, solution architects, customer teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Manage competing priorities, dependencies, and cross-functional requirements.
  • Provide clear communication and actionable guidance during periods of ambiguity or change.
  • Lead teams through delivery challenges while maintaining alignment on project goals and outcomes.

Manage Risks and Drive Successful Outcomes

  • Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies early.
  • Develop mitigation and escalation strategies as appropriate.
  • Support change management, stakeholder alignment, and user adoption activities.
  • Balance customer expectations with successful delivery outcomes.

Contribute Beyond Your Projects

  • Help improve Project Management and Implementation Services standards, methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  • Share lessons learned and delivery expertise across the broader Project Management community.
  • Support delivery excellence initiatives that strengthen the customer experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Projects are delivered predictably, with risks identified and managed proactively.
  • Customers are informed, engaged, and confident throughout the implementation journey.
  • Delivery teams remain aligned, focused, and accountable.
  • Scope, timelines, budgets, and quality standards are actively managed and respected.
  • Customers achieve meaningful business outcomes through their Intelex solutions.
  • Stakeholders trust your judgment and rely on your leadership.

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Manager, Project Management and be part of a global Implementation Services organisation.

You will collaborate closely with:

  • Implementation Consultants
  • Solution Architects
  • Customer Success Managers
  • Product Management
  • Support Services
  • Customer stakeholders and executive sponsors

You will have access to a global community of experienced Project Managers, consultants, architects, and subject matter experts committed to helping customers succeed.

What You Bring on Day One

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of Project Management experience delivering SaaS, enterprise software, or technology implementation projects.
  • Strong understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project delivery methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
  • Strong understanding of project delivery fundamentals including scope, schedule, risk, budget, quality, and stakeholder management.
  • Experience working directly with customers and senior business stakeholders.
  • Experience managing customer-facing projects involving multiple stakeholder groups and executive-level sponsors.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Ability to lead through influence in cross-functional environments.
  • Strong organisational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Preferred

  • 5+ years of Project Management experience delivering SaaS, enterprise software, or technology implementation projects.
  • Experience delivering software implementations within a SaaS environment.
  • Experience delivering Environmental, Sustainability, ESG, Carbon Management, EHS, Quality, regulatory compliance, or operational excellence initiatives.
  • Familiarity with environmental reporting, sustainability management, ESG disclosure, carbon accounting, environmental compliance, or related business processes.
  • Educational background in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Environmental Management, Engineering, or related fields.
  • PRINCE2, APM PMQ, PMP, or equivalent Project Management certification.
  • Experience delivering projects across EMEA or within globally distributed customer environments.
  • Comfortable working within globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers in manufacturing, energy, utilities, infrastructure, natural resources, chemical, or sustainability-focused industries.
  • Understanding of application integrations and enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Membership with the Association for Project Management (APM) is considered an asset.

How You Operate

Top performers in this role are:

  • Accountable and ownership-driven
  • Customer-focused and consultative
  • Structured and disciplined
  • Adaptable and resilient
  • Collaborative and team-oriented
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity
  • Growth-minded and eager to learn
  • Passionate about helping customers achieve meaningful business outcomes

Additional Details

  • Remote UK-based position.
  • Travel to customer locations may be required, up to 30% depending on project and business needs.
  • Eligible for bonus as part of total compensation.
  • Employment is contingent upon satisfactory background verification where applicable.

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

Since 1992, Intelex Technologies, ULC. is a global leader in the development and support of software solutions for Environment, Health, Safety and Quality (EHSQ) programs. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

  • Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.
  • Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.
  • Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.
  • Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world-class resource for Data Centre operators and users.
  • Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.
  • Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.
  • Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

  • Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation
  • Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back-end roles, or TypeScript, React for front-end roles.
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal
  • Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP
  • Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)

  • Ideally, experience of large-scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals.   • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

About the Organization

Our client is a Palestinian-owned, mission-led organization connecting small-scale farmers across Palestine directly with consumers worldwide. Their model is farm-first and regenerative, built around long-term partnerships with trusted growers, fairer pricing, and single-estate extra virgin olive oils sourced using traditional and modern cold-press methods.

Every bottle is fully traceable to its specific region and farm and reflects the people, land, and centuries-old heritage behind the product. Beyond commerce, the organization aims to create a global gateway for Palestinian farmers to share their produce, culture, and commitment to sustainable practices.The client’s name and additional details will be shared with shortlisted candidates before the client interview.

  • Create high-quality static creative across website and product pages, advertising, email, social media, packaging, product design support, and brand assets.

  • Translate the Creative Director’s art direction, concepts, templates, and feedback into polished, production-ready designs.

  • Work within and extend existing brand guidelines, templates, typography, color palettes, layouts, and design systems while maintaining a consistent visual identity.

  • Adapt creative concepts across different placements, dimensions, formats, and markets while maintaining brand consistency.

  • Design ad statics and carousels, as well as email, social, website, and product-page graphics.

  • Support packaging and product design needs, ensuring physical and digital creative remain cohesive.

  • Work from creative briefs and collaborate with the Creative Strategist and Retention Manager to understand requirements and deliverables.

  • Manage multiple creative requests, iterate based on feedback, and deliver consistently high-quality work at an agreed pace.

  • Prepare final assets accurately for their intended digital or print applications.

  • Use strong judgment around composition, typography, color, hierarchy, spacing, and visual storytelling.

  • Work independently and reliably, managing priorities, deadlines, communication, and deliverables as a remote contractor.

What you bring

  • An artist-first approach to design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating visual craft, taste, range, and quality across brand and marketing design.

  • A strong eye for composition, typography, color, layout, hierarchy, and visual detail.

  • Professional experience creatingstatic graphic design across multiple surfaces, including web, social, advertising, email, print, or packaging.

  • Strong proficiency withFigma, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

  • Ability to work within an established brand identity and execute someone else’s creative direction while maintaining your own high standard of craft.

  • Experience adapting creative across different formats, placements, and channels while maintaining consistency.

  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and the ability to produce polished work consistently across a batch of deliverables.

  • Ability to take feedback, iterate quickly, and manage multiple creative requests and deadlines.

  • Commitment to creating original design work without AI-generated imagery, in line with the brand’s emphasis on authenticity and real, provable origin.

Helpful but not essential

  • Experience designing for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

  • Experience with advertising and marketing creative.

  • Experience with motion design or animation.

  • Experience with packaging or product design.

  • Familiarity with the Palestinian story, culture, and mission, or a strong personal connection to the organization’s purpose.

  • Your portfoliowill be a key part of the evaluation, with particular attention to artistry, range, visual taste, and quality across brand and marketing design.

  • You will completea paid trialconsisting of a set of pieces from a real creative brief, working from the Creative Director’s existing templates and art direction.

  • We will evaluate consistency across the full set of deliverables, not just the quality of one individual or “hero” piece.

How the engagement works

  • The hiring process begins with a conversation with the recruitment team to discuss your experience, portfolio, availability, and mutual expectations.

We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.

  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. Role Overview

Lynx Software Technologies is seeking an experienced Director, Capture Management to help drive strategic growth across the Aerospace, Defense, and Safety-Critical Systems markets.   • Develop compelling win themes around safety certification, cybersecurity, open architecture, software portability, lifecycle cost reduction, and mission assurance.

Government Contracting & Compliance

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to align customer requirements with product roadmaps and technical capabilities.
  • Work with Marketing to create targeted campaign messaging, pursuit-specific collateral, and customer-facing content.

Role Summary

The Chief Digital Assets Officer (CDAO) is responsible for leading the organization's digital assets strategy, including tokenized assets, digital securities, cryptocurrencies, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), custody solutions, and blockchain-enabled financial products. This executive role oversees the development, governance, commercialization, and regulatory compliance of digital asset initiatives while driving innovation and sustainable growth in the evolving digital economy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Assets Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital assets and tokenization strategy.
  • Identify opportunities for digital asset adoption, monetization, and business growth.
  • Advise the CEO, Board, and executive leadership on digital asset trends, risks, and market developments.
  • Establish long-term digital asset roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy.

2. Digital Asset Product Development

  • Lead the creation and commercialization of digital asset products and services.
  • Oversee tokenized investment products, digital securities, stablecoin initiatives, and custody offerings.
  • Drive innovation in digital asset trading, settlement, and asset management solutions.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and regulatory compliance of digital asset platforms.

3. Tokenization & Digital Securities

  • Develop tokenization strategies for financial instruments, real-world assets, and alternative investments.
  • Lead digital securities issuance and lifecycle management initiatives.
  • Evaluate opportunities in asset tokenization and fractional ownership models.
  • Drive adoption of blockchain-enabled financial infrastructure.

4. Digital Asset Operations & Custody

  • Oversee custody frameworks and asset protection mechanisms.
  • Ensure operational resilience and secure management of digital assets.
  • Implement governance controls for wallets, private keys, and settlement processes.
  • Establish operational best practices and service standards.

5. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with digital asset regulations and financial market requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Information Security functions.
  • Manage regulatory licensing, reporting, and audit obligations.
  • Monitor developments from regulators and industry bodies affecting digital assets.

6. Market Development & Strategic Partnerships

  • Build partnerships with exchanges, custodians, financial institutions, fintechs, and blockchain providers.
  • Develop strategic alliances to expand digital asset capabilities and market access.
  • Represent the organization within digital asset industry forums and working groups.
  • Support ecosystem growth and institutional adoption initiatives.

7. Technology & Innovation

  • Partner with technology teams to develop blockchain-based digital asset infrastructure.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies supporting digital assets and tokenization.
  • Drive innovation in settlement, custody, interoperability, and smart contract capabilities.
  • Support integration of digital assets into existing financial systems.

8. Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build and lead high-performing digital asset, product, operations, and compliance teams.
  • Develop internal expertise in digital assets, tokenization, and blockchain technologies.
  • Manage budgets, investments, and vendor relationships.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, governance, and operational excellence.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Technology, Computer Science, Law, or related field.
  • MBA, Master's degree, CFA, JD/LLB, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in financial services, capital markets, asset management, fintech, digital assets, or blockchain-related sectors.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior executive leadership role.
  • Proven experience with digital assets, tokenization, digital securities, custody, or blockchain-enabled financial products.
  • Strong understanding of capital markets, financial regulations, custody operations, and digital asset ecosystems.

Key Competencies

  • Digital Assets Strategy
  • Tokenization & Digital Securities
  • Capital Markets & Asset Management
  • Blockchain & Distributed Ledger Technology
  • Digital Asset Custody & Operations
  • Cryptocurrency & Stablecoin Ecosystems
  • Regulatory Compliance & Governance
  • Risk Management
  • Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development
  • Product Innovation & Commercialization

jobs.title: Staff Information Security Engineer - AI First
jobs.excerpt: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences.
jobs.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.

Rithum is embedding AI into every corner of how it operates — and security is no exception.

As a Staff AI-First Information Security Engineer, you own the intersection of AI adoption and information security: designing guardrails for AI-powered products, building automated security tooling, designing security controls and monitoring for an AI-First workforce, helping every team at Rithum move fast without creating risk they cannot see. This is not a typical security role. You spend as much time building and automating as you do reviewing, turning a repeating control into infrastructure-as-code, a manual review into a workflow, and a vague AI risk into a concrete, enforced guardrails. You work autonomously, balancing research with fast-paced delivery, and collaborating closely with Platform Engineering, IT, Security Champions, and external auditors.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the bridge between architectural intent and operational reality; mediate conflicts between security requirements and feasible implementation, propose compensating controls where gaps exist and help register, track and remediate residual risks.
  • Implement preventive, default-on security controls across cloud and enterprise environments, codified as policy- and infrastructure-as-code so security is enforced by design, including controls that govern how AI tools and models may be used.
  • Implement and enforce identity and access controls to an agreed standard, including access boundaries for AI systems and non-human/agent identities by partnering with Platform Engineering and IT to align tooling and policy to the architecture.
  • Assist in maintaining the InfoSec risk register; track emerging threats and translate them into actionable guidance for engineering teams.
  • Support third-party and vendor risk assessments, with a focus on vendors who process data through AI pipelines.
  • Automate repetitive security workflows (evidence collection, access reviews, alert enrichment) and build or operate AI-assisted security agents — with human-in-the-loop approval gates, least-privilege credentials, and explicit attention to each agent's own blast radius.
  • Integrate security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, DAST/SAST, vulnerability scanners) with LLM layers to surface actionable insight and automated responses.
  • Define and enforce security requirements for AI-powered features: model access controls, prompt-injection mitigations, output validation, and data-handling boundaries.
  • Conduct threat modelling on agentic and LLM-based systems, accounting for novel attack surfaces such as tool misuse, indirect prompt injection, and supply chain risk.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of security engineering experience with demonstrated AI/ML security depth (prompt injection, model supply chain, adversarial inputs, RAG).
  • Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) and LLM frameworks and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, or similar) to accelerate and elevate your work.
  • Hands-on identity and access expertise across modern enterprise and cloud identity stacks, including access models for AI systems and non-human identities.
  • Infrastructure and policy-as-code (e.g. Terraform, OPA/Rego) and proficiency in a scripting language for automation (Python preferred).
  • Cloud security expertise: AWS Solutions Architect / Security Specialty or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including multi-account governance, preventive guardrails, and policy-as-code.
  • Application security (OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM/GenAI Top 10, secure SDLC) and threat-modelling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent). Practical experience building or operating AI agents, and integrating security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, SAST/DAST/SCA) so it surfaces action rather than raw alerts.
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 control frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating AI agents in a production environment.
  • Awareness of privacy regulation (GDPR/CCPA) as it touches AI including privacy-by-design and DPIAs.
  • Red teaming or adversarial ML research backgrounds.
  • Experience implementing privileged-access, key-management, posture-management, or data-protection programs.
  • Experience with EDR, CASB, DLP, Security automation and SAST, DAST, IAST and SCA tools.
  • Cloud Architecture or Security certifications (CCSK, TAISE, AWS).

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $170,000-$220,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 12% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits: Affordable health care plans and company HSA contributions, starting on Day 1
  • A 6% 401(k) match
  • Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 9 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days
  • 12 weeks primary caregiver leave & 4 weeks secondary caregiver leave
  • Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • Pet insurance
  • Legal assistance and identity theft insurance plans
  • Life insurance 2x salary

  • $65/month Remote work stipend for internet

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

This role focuses on building high-performance ETL pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data from diverse operational systems into enterprise data warehouses and cloud-based analytics platforms.

Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.

Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.

Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human.

We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.

The opportunity

As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.

What you’ll do

  • Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.
  • Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.
  • Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.
  • Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.
  • Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.

  • Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.
  • Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.
  • Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.
  • Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.
  • Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.

What success looks like

We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:

  • Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.
  • Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.
  • The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.
  • Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.
  • Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.
  • A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.
  • Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.
  • A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.
  • The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.
  • A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.

Minimum Experience

  • Experience with GRC platforms such as Archer, including report management, data fields, layouts, or related configuration preferred

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to data accuracy, completeness, and reporting detail

  • interessante, anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem qualifizierten und dynamischen Team
  • die Möglichkeit zu flexibler Zeiteinteilung und eigenständigem Arbeiten
  • ein modernes, kollegiales und digitales Arbeitsumfeld
  • Raum für Kreativität und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Produktionsplanung und -steuerung (PPS) finden heutzutage stark IT-gestützt durch Business-Software wie ERP- und ME-Systeme statt. Die Abläufe und Methoden basieren dabei zwar auf etablierten wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen, allerdings haben sich die Systeme in den vergangenen Jahren unabhängig weiterentwickelt. In der Praxis treten immer wieder Probleme bei der Verknüpfung verschiedener Systeme auf, da Datenmodelle nicht klar definiert und Schnittstellen nicht beschrieben sind. Folglich ist eine Vergleichbarkeit verschiedener PPSKonfigurationen ohne ein geeignetes Simulationsmodell nicht möglich.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.

About This Role:

As a Software Engineer for Network Architecture and SDN at TeraWave, you contribute technical expertise to the design and implementation of the network that operates our multi-orbit constellation of 5,408 optically interconnected satellites. You develop a dynamic, self-healing network that functions at orbital speeds, supporting inter-satellite links that move at 27,000 km/h and seamless handoffs for users on the ground, all within strict power and latency budgets. You apply expertise in networking architecture and software-defined networking to build critical components of our space-based communications system. You collaborate with principal engineers and technical leaders on routing, traffic management, and network resilience, and you mentor junior engineers on networking best practices.

In this role, you will apply your strong expertise in networking architecture and software-defined networking to develop critical components of our space-based communications system. You will collaborate with principal engineers, senior software developers, and technical leaders to implement innovative approaches to routing, traffic management, and network resilience. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced communications technology and orbital mechanics, making significant technical contributions to a revolutionary system.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop routing solutions, topology management, and fast-reroute mechanisms tailored for time-varying LEO satellite constellations.

  • Implement software-defined networking frameworks that support centralized and distributed control planes across the constellation.

  • Implement self-healing network logic where real-time telemetry drives automated congestion management and fault isolation.

  • Develop observability components using in-band and out-of-band telemetry for packet-level visibility and flow-level tracing.

  • Implement packet forwarding solutions that operate reliably in space, optimizing latency and throughput under power constraints.

  • Support cross-layer optimization with RF and Silicon teams to ensure mobility across beams and satellites.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

  • Five or more years of experience in software development for networks, distributed systems, or telecommunications.

  • Experience implementing SDN controllers and programmable data planes such as P4, OpenFlow, or proprietary frameworks.

  • Experience implementing network solutions for wireless, cloud, or service provider networks.

  • Experience developing software for mission-critical systems in production environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

  • Experience with satellite communications networks or terrestrial and satellite hybrid networks.

  • Knowledge of BGP, IS-IS, OSPF, and Segment Routing (SRv6 or SR-MPLS) in production network environments.

  • Understanding of packet processing, ASIC or FPGA forwarding logic, and high-speed switching.

  • Background in graph theory or network optimization, with modeling and simulation tools for network performance analysis.

  • Contributions to networking projects, internally or open-source, and understanding of regulatory considerations for communications systems.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical written and verbal communication skills.

The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.

Job Description

Are you a former technician, shop foreman, fleet maintenance professional, service advisor, or OEM warranty administrator looking to leverage your mechanical expertise without spending every day in the shop?

As a Fleet Service Advisor I, you'll serve as a trusted maintenance partner for commercial fleet customers, acting as an extension of their maintenance department. In this role, you will review repair recommendations, evaluate maintenance needs, authorize repairs, and help customers balance vehicle uptime, safety, and maintenance costs.

Using your mechanical expertise and sound judgment, you'll ensure repairs adhere to customer maintenance programs, OEM guidelines, and industry best practices while delivering an exceptional customer experience. Fleet Service Advisors work closely with repair facilities, technicians, vendors, and customers to make informed maintenance decisions, control costs, and minimize vehicle downtime.

This is an ideal opportunity for individuals with automotive, diesel, trucking, dealership, fleet maintenance, warranty administration, or service advising experience who want to transition their hands-on technical knowledge into a remote, office-based role while continuing to solve complex maintenance and repair challenges.

Work Schedule: This position supports a 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM Eastern Time shift.

Work Location: This position may be performed remotely anywhere within the United States. Qualified candidates will be considered regardless of geographic location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review repair estimates, diagnostics, and maintenance recommendations for commercial vehicles and equipment.

  • Evaluate repair needs based on customer maintenance policies, OEM guidelines, warranty considerations, and industry best practices.

  • Authorize repairs and maintenance services within established approval guidelines.

  • Analyze labor operations, parts requirements, and repair recommendations for accuracy, necessity, and cost effectiveness.

  • Utilize vehicle repair history, maintenance records, warranty information, parts pricing, labor standards, and repair best practices to support maintenance decisions.

  • Communicate with repair facilities, technicians, vendors, and customers to obtain diagnostic information and clarify repair recommendations.

  • Act as an advocate for customers by helping manage repairs on their behalf and ensuring service providers meet customer maintenance expectations.

  • Audit managed repairs and preventive maintenance inspections to ensure accuracy, validity, and compliance with customer standards.

  • Research maintenance history and prior repairs to support repair authorization decisions.

  • Assist in resolving invoice discrepancies, estimate variances, maintenance-related disputes, and billing concerns.

  • Support preventive maintenance program compliance and vehicle maintenance scheduling activities.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, service providers, and customers to minimize vehicle downtime and ensure timely repair completion.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of repair authorizations, recommendations, and case activity.

  • Deliver an exceptional customer experience through timely communication, quality service, and sound maintenance decision making.

  • Manage multiple repair cases simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of experience in fleet maintenance, diesel repair, automotive repair, warranty administration, service advising, vehicle maintenance operations, or a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as an associate degree and 2 years of experience; a bachelor's degree in a related discipline; or 8 years of related experience.

  • Strong working knowledge of automotive, diesel, or commercial vehicle maintenance and repair.

  • Ability to understand vehicle diagnostics, repair recommendations, and maintenance requirements.

  • Ability to interpret repair estimates, labor operations, parts requirements, maintenance recommendations, and warranty considerations.

  • Strong computer proficiency and ability to navigate multiple software systems simultaneously.

  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • High attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

  • Ability to manage a high-volume workload while maintaining quality and customer service standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ASE Certification(s) or other industry-recognized maintenance certifications.

  • Experience supporting medium-duty and heavy-duty commercial fleets.

  • Experience in fleet management, transportation, trucking, dealership service operations, or OEM warranty administration.

  • Previous experience reviewing repair estimates, warranty claims, maintenance authorizations, or vendor invoices.

  • Knowledge of preventive maintenance programs, DOT compliance requirements, and OEM maintenance standards.

  • Previous mechanical training or hands-on technician experience.

Examples of Applicable Mechanical Knowledge

Successful candidates should be comfortable discussing and evaluating topics such as:

  • Preventive maintenance programs and service intervals.

  • Engine diagnostics.

  • Emissions systems and regeneration (DPF/regen) processes.

  • Cooling, fuel, braking, suspension, and electrical systems.

  • Labor operations and repair procedures.

  • OEM maintenance recommendations.

  • Warranty coverage and repair eligibility.

  • Parts pricing and repair cost analysis.

  • Vehicle inspection findings and maintenance requirements.

What Success Looks Like

  • Making sound maintenance authorization decisions that balance vehicle reliability, safety, and cost control.

  • Accurately evaluating repair recommendations and maintenance estimates from service providers.

  • Demonstrating strong mechanical judgment and problem-solving skills.

  • Maintaining thorough, accurate, and detailed case documentation.

  • Delivering timely and professional communication to customers and vendors.

  • Helping customers maximize vehicle uptime while controlling maintenance expenses.

  • Providing an exceptional customer experience and serving as a trusted maintenance resource.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has a strong mechanical background and enjoys solving technical problems in an office environment. They understand how vehicles operate, can evaluate repair recommendations with confidence, and are comfortable making decisions that balance vehicle uptime, maintenance costs, safety requirements, and customer expectations.

Former technicians, shop foremen, service advisors, fleet maintenance professionals, and OEM warranty administrators who are looking to apply their expertise in a consultative, customer-focused role are especially encouraged to apply.

Drug Testing

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Benefits

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

About Us

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. Responsibilities include validating integration between GT controls, BESS EMS/PPC systems, SCADA, and overall coordination strategies (frequency response, voltage control, inertia management, black start, load rejection, and large motor/data center step loads).

The position requires strong cross-disciplinary leadership, risk identification capability, and the ability to translate complex control interactions into clear recommendations for owner and lender stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include engineering design reviews, technical due diligence, project development support, and conceptual design. Particular experience in electrical design of thermal power projects is desired.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm.
jobs.description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.

We put delivery dates in contracts and carry the overage risk ourselves. That only works if someone owns the delivery — scope, timeline, budget, and sprint execution and treats a slipping date as their problem, not a status-report line item. That someone is you.

As our Technical Project Manager, you'll run distributed engineering teams across India and three US time zones on customer engagements where the date is committed. You'll run the daily, sprint, and client cadences, translate fluently between engineering and business stakeholders, and push back on scope creep with data. Agents compress the repetitive engineering work, which makes delivery faster and makes your job sharper: shorter timelines leave no room for blockers that sit in a log for days. We're looking for the PM who gets things done who personally removes blockers, drives escalations to closure, and makes sure no risk reaches the client as a surprise.

This role is not for you if:

  • Your default is to forward messages between the client and engineering.
  • Your role has primarily been reporting and coordination without delivery ownership.
  • You've only facilitated agile ceremonies without driving delivery outcomes.
  • Sprint ownership and execution were largely driven by a Business Analyst or Product Owner in your previous roles.

What you will do

  • Build the project plan in Smartsheet from the Solutions Architect's scope of work, real dependencies, a defensible critical path, sprint boundaries overlaid on the timeline.
  • Track scope, hours, and budget in real time. Flag burn-rate risk early and push back on scope creep with numbers, not gut feel.
  • Maintain a live risk register. Spot risks before they become issues, surface the right ones to the client at the right time, and drive mitigation actively.
  • Maintain a live RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and an action tracker with clear ownership, accountability, and timely closure.
  • Run crisp daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives that produce decisions, not discussions.
  • Remove sprint blockers personally. Chase the client-side data dependency, escalate the stuck cloud permission, redirect pulled resources don't let "waiting on" sit in a log for days.
  • Handle sprint-level risks in real time: reprioritize, descope, swap stories, or escalate before commitments slip.
  • Keep trackers honest. Action items have owners and dates; delays are visible and followed up on time.
  • Translate technical progress into business language for the customer, and business priorities into clear, estimable requirements for engineers.
  • Facilitate internal and external architecture reviews across India and three US time zones; document decisions and circulate them the same day.

This includes leading AI‑related research, experimentation, prototyping, and the creation of high‑quality product and governance artifacts aligned to Origami Risk standards and applicable regulatory requirements.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states).

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $40/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

As a Cloud Engineer on the Security team, you’ll help mature Included Health’s cloud security posture across primarily AWS environments, with consideration for GCP. You’ll design, implement, and automate controls that protect product infrastructure and help prevent unauthorized Protected Health Information (PHI) exfiltration.

This is a full-time, remote role reporting to the Senior Manager, Security Engineering. We are open to considering candidates at both the Senior and Staff levels.

The role requires hands-on technical execution as well as the ability to influence infrastructure, DevOps, engineering, and product teams.

What You'll Do

  • Design and automate cloud security controls across Identity & Access Management (IAM), authorization, Just-in-Time access, data access, and platform access.
  • Improve AWS and GCP security posture through Terraform guardrails, risk roadmaps, legacy remediation, and secure infrastructure patterns.
  • Build security tooling in Python, Go, and Lambda for vulnerability management, alerting, PHI logging, and cloud security workflows.
  • Secure containers, workloads, and CI/CD pipelines through practical controls teams can operate in production.

    You build trust through preparation, responsiveness, direct communication, technical credibility, and follow-through. You listen to operational realities, explaining risks and tradeoffs clearly, and work with teams toward practical controls they can operate in production.

    You take ownership through the full loop: coordination, escalation, validation, closure, and knowledge sharing. You know when to investigate independently, when to involve the right expertise, and when broader organizational alignment is needed.

This is more than a system administration role.

The successful implementation of iTrent has already transformed payroll operations and provided a robust platform for future development.   • Git-based development, pull requests, code review, and CI/CD
  • Experience with Snowflake and SnowSQL (preferred)
  • Experience with Metabase (preferred)
  • Python proficiency (preferred)
